and if you go up from there, you can walk along the back line.
To return to the front, do the opposite.

Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!

Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

...See ya!
entries.よぉ、にィちゃんも\nこの先に行きたいのかい?\n\nそりゃぁムリだ・・・\nこ:
Hey, Niichan too,
do you want to go further?

That's impossible...
Beyond this point, it's completely white.

If the Kiri runs out,
you can go, though...
entries.まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば\n何とかなるみたいだけど・・・\:
Well, according to what I heard, if there's a violent tornado,
it seems like we can manage somehow...
But seriously, where on earth is something like that...?

I've given up!
You should think about it too, big brother...

Goodbye!
entries.オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ\n何か たべるもん ないか?・・・\:
I'm hungry right now and I'm getting irritated.
Is there anything I can eat?...
If not, please save it for later.
entries.オ〜〜〜ッ!\nなんだ それくれるのか?\n\nサンキュー! たすかったゼ\nも:
Ohhhh!
What? You're giving me that?

Thanks! That saved me.
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa—nice to meet you.
entries.そうだ!!\nとっておきの技をおしえてやるョ\n\nいいか?:
That's right!!
I'll teach you my secret technique!

Is that okay?
entries.×ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、\n人よんで ケモノダッシュってい: Pressing the X button while running makes your speed increase—it's called "Kemono Dash," a technique used by humans.
entries.○ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、\n人よんで ケモノダッシュってい: Running while pressing the ○ button makes your speed increase—it's a technique called "Kemono Dash," you know.
entries.おぼえたか?\n×ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・\nじゃぁオレはいくゼ\n\:
Did you remember?
While pressing the X button...
Well then, I'm off!

Goodbye!
entries.おぼえたか?\n○ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・\nじゃぁオレはいくゼ\n\:
Did you remember?
While pressing the ○ button...
Well then, I'm off!

Goodbye!
entries.・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!\n\nかくれてたんだけど よくわかった:
...Oh dear... I've already been found!

I was hiding, but you figured it out so well...
entries.よし! いいことおしえてやるよ\n\nこの小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるい:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

If you go straight to the back of this hut, there's a gate,
And if you go up past this hut,
There's an old man called the 100-year-old living there.
entries.え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・\nそんなことより まず行ってみろよ、\nウソ:
Huh?... Is that me?...
Rather than that, first go and see it,
It's not a lie...

After that, let's meet again.
entries.100年老人には会ったのかい?\n\n会ったら また会おうや:
Have you met the 100-year-old?

If you do, let's meet again.
entries.ふるいけ には行ったかい?\n\n行ったら また会おうや:
Did you go to Furuike?

If you did, let's meet again.
entries.どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ\n\nじまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってん:
How about it, it wasn't a lie, right?

It's not a joke, but I know a lot.
entries.・・・あぁ、オイラかい?\n\nオイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・:
...Ah, me?

I'm Yan, from the Hidden Village...
entries.いつも かくれてるんだけど、\nだれも見つけられないんだ・・・\n\nまた見つけ:
I always hide,
but no one can find me...

If I can be found again,
I'll tell you something good then too!
...If I can be found.
entries.う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・\nがんばって見つけてくれよ\n\n:
Hmm... I'm starting to feel like I'm having fun now...
Please do your best to find it!

See ya!
entries.この先に行く気か?\n\nでも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?:
Are you going to go ahead?

But… can you swim?
entries.いかん、いかん\n\n今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが\n次からそうはいかん\:
No, no.

I got help from the turtle this time,
but I can't do that again next time.

Beyond that door,
you can't go unless you can swim...

Don't say bad things,
it's better to stop now...

I'll go when I can swim someday.

Oh, right!
Are you hungry?

Take this!
entries.おおっ! おまえ およげるんかィ\n・・・でも、ここには カギが かかっててな、:
Wow! You can swim, huh?
...But there's a lock here, so I can't get to the other side right now...
entries.ん〜っ・・・見たところ 文明の国にいる\n鉄人の作ったカギみたいだけどナ・・・:
Hmm... from what I can see, it's in a civilized country.
It looks like a key made by an iron man, but na...
entries.な〜んだ 持ってたんかィ・・・\nでも、気ィつけて行けよ・・・\n\nおれは、キ:
Oh, you had it...
But be careful when you go...

I'm on a boat near the beach road near the mushroom forest,
so if you feel like it, take a peek.

Oh, right! Are you hungry?
Take this.
entries.木の枝にぶらさがると 大回転ができる!\n方向キー◀か→ を押しつづけると 回転:
When hanging from a tree branch, you can do a big spin!
Press and hold the direction key ◀ or → to spin.
To reverse the rotation, press the opposite direction key.
entries.ジャンプしたい方向の方向キーを 押しながら\n×ボタンを 押して ジャンプ!!\:
Press the direction key for the direction you want to jump while pressing the × button to jump!!
The jump distance changes depending on how long you press the × button.
Timing doesn't matter at all!!
entries.ジャンプしたい方向の方向キーを 押しながら\n○ボタンを 押して ジャンプ!!\:
Press the direction key for the direction you want to jump while pressing the ○ button to jump!!
The jump distance changes depending on how long you press the ○ button.
Timing doesn't matter at all!!
entries.・・・うーん・・・こまったのォ・・・\n\nどーしたもんかのォ・・・\n\nんっ:
...Hmm... I'm in trouble...

What should I do...?

Hmm?
entries.なんじゃ?・・・\nわしが100年老人じゃが・・・何か用かな?:
What is it?...
I am a 100-year-old old man... Is there something you need?
entries.すまんが、ちょっと\n考えごとをしておってな・・・・・・\n\n・・・おお そう:
Sorry, I'm just thinking about something...

...Oh, that's right!
Hey, would you do me a favor?
What I mean by "favor" is...

You probably saw it when you came here,
that red-breasted chick,

stealing eggs from other places
and then making them his own...

If things continue like this,
the chicks inside will be pitiful...

So, could you gather all the chicks
inside the eggs around here?
entries.しんぱいじゃからな・・・\nたのんだぞ:
I'm worried...
I'm counting on you.
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか?\n\nん〜〜〜っ・・・\nじゃが まだ残っとる:
What? Are they already gathering?

Hmm~~~...
But it seems like there's still some left...

Sorry, could you go again?
entries.集めてくれたのか?・・・\nん〜〜〜っ・・・\n\nじゃが まだ残っとるようじゃ:
Did you collect them?...
Hmmmmm...

But it seems there's still some left...
Sorry, but could you go again?
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか・・・\nおおぉぉぉっ!しかも全部集まっとるではな:
What? Already gathered...?
Ohhhhh! And they're all gathered!
...And where are the contents?
entries.おー・まい・がっ!!\n\nハラの中に入れとったのか!?\n\nまぁ、しかし 消:
Oh my god!!

Did you put it in the stomach!?

Well, but it doesn't seem to be digested,
so I'll leave it at that.

Well, anyway, it was exhausting.
...With this, I can rest easy.

Hmm?...That's right, that's right.
It seems like there was something you wanted from me.

...Hmm...
Did Komabuta take the memento of Ojiisan's arm...?

So, you want to ask about Komabuta and the others...

Hmm, I understand...
Actually, no...
entries.集めてくれたのか?\n\n・・・おぉっ!! 全部集まったようじゃな\n・・・・・:
Did you gather them?

...Oh! It looks like everything's been collected.
...And where are the contents?
entries.わしが話してやれる事はここまでじゃ・・・\n\nもしおまえさんがこの先の方を進む:
This is as far as I can go in telling you...

If you're going to move forward from here,
you should try looking for my companions,
and I'm sure they'll be able to help you...
entries.あとは・・・ そうじゃな・・・\n\nアイテムを 手にいれたら・・\n「アイテム:
After that... well...

Once you get an item...
Select "View" from the "Item" command,
and take your time looking at it carefully...

Surely, you'll notice something...
entries.おや?ないのぉ・・・\nおまえさんに100年のすずを\nやろうとおもったんじゃが:
Oh? It's gone...
I was going to give you a hundred years of tin...

It seems like you lost it somewhere...

If you find something like it,
bring it to me...

In exchange, I'll give you this... Here, take this—it's a hundred-year key.
entries.これで、ここにあるのとおなじ宝箱なら\nあけることができるようになったはずじゃ・:
With this, you should now be able to open the same treasure chests as the ones here...
Hmm, what luck!
entries.それと・・・魔ブタをさがすには、\n封印ぶくろ と呼ばれるモノが必要じゃ・・・\:
And... to find the Demon Pig, you need something called a Seal Pouch...

Without it,
the hiding place becomes invisible...
entries.封印ぶくろのことは、この先の森に住む\nドワーフの長老にきいてみるといい・・・\:
As for the sealed bag, you should ask the elder of the dwarves who live in the forest ahead...
They should be able to tell you more about it.
entries.・・・まだまだ先は長い・・・\nあせってケガなど せんようにな・・・:
...The road ahead is still long...
Don't rush and get injured...
entries.・・・おおっ、これはまさしく100年のすず!\nよく見つけたのぉ・・・\n\nこ:
...Oh wow, this is exactly 100 years of Suzu!
You found it well...

If you use this, you should be able to come back here anytime...
entries.よく やったのぉ・・・・・・\n\nこれで この大陸も もとの静けさを\nとりも:
Well done…

With this, this continent will regain its original tranquility…
entries.ふん! \nまぁ、マグレじゃろうけどな・・・:
Hmph!
Well, it's probably just a fluke...
entries.ほっ ほっ ほっ・・・\n何を言うとる・・・\n\nいちばん心配しとったクセに・:
Ho ho ho...
What are you saying...?

You were the most worried, weren't you...?
You're not being honest, are you...?
entries.なっ! 何を・・・\n別に わしは心配なんか・・・・・・:
What! What are you...
I'm not worried about anything...
entries.まぁまぁ・・・\n・・・ともかく・・・\n\nこの少年の勇気が \n皆を救ってく:
Well, well...
...Anyway...

This boy's courage
saved everyone, didn't it?
entries.・・・そうじゃな・・・・\n・・で?\nおまえさんの目的は はたせたのかな?\n:
...That's right...
...And?
Did you achieve your goal?

...
...I see.
...That's good.
entries.・・・そうか・・・\n\n・・・わしら時の老人は トンバとともにある・・・\n・:
...I see...

...Our old man is with Tomba...
...If anything happens, come visit us again.
entries.げ・・・元気でな・・・\n\n気をつけてかえれよ・・・\n\nカゼひくなよ・・・:
Be careful on your way home...

Don't catch a cold...

Um, and also...
entries.まったく・・・\n自分のマゴに話してるみたいじゃな・・・\nほっ ほっ ほっ・・:
Seriously...
It feels like I'm talking to my own mago...
Ho ho ho...
entries.・・・恵みコゾウが復活すると、幻の塔が現れる・・・: ...When the Blessing Kozo revives, the Phantom Tower will appear...
entries.・・・ドワーフの集落に花の種をまくと、\n 金色の花がさく・・・:
...When you sow flower seeds in the dwarven village,
golden flowers bloom...
entries.・・・山の頂上には、かくれた村がある・・・: ...At the top of the mountain, there is a hidden village...
entries.・・・ウワサを聞いた後、納屋のある小屋に\n 魔王がかえってくる・・・: ...After hearing the rumor, the Demon King returns to the shed where the barn is located...

Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting butterflies...

According to rumors, butterflies have
mysterious powers...

If you collect a few, something amazing
seems to happen...

If you want to see what happens,
put the butterflies you caught
inside this Mukashio.
entries.なんだ・・・もう\nもってたのか・・・:
What... already?
Did you have it...?
entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今2匹ぐらいだな・・・:
Hii... fuu... mi...
There are about two butterflies now...
entries.な!?・・・何だ、何だ?: What!?... What is it, what is it?
entries.・・・おりれなくなっちゃった\n\n花の種をさがしにきたんだけど・・・\nどこに:
...I can't go back anymore.

I came looking for flower seeds, but...
I can't find any anywhere...

I want to go home...
entries.・・・おにいちゃん、\nつれてってくれるの?\n・・・・・・ありがとう!:
...Big brother,
will you take me?
...Thank you!
entries.・・・おにいちゃん、\nそっちじゃないとおもうよ:
...Older brother,
I don't think it's that way.
entries.いや・・・\nどこにもいない:
No...
He's nowhere to be found.
entries.いや、それ\nわからない・・・\n\nでも、このもりで\n見たドワーフいる:
No, that...
I don't know...

But, in this forest,
there's a dwarf I saw.
entries.でも、いくら 大ドロボウでも\nこんなところまでぬけ方つくるのは、とても大変・・:
But even for a big thief,
it's very difficult to make an escape route like this...
entries.・・・うわぁっ!!!\n・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・\nなんだ、いつかのガ:
...Whoa!!!
...B-...I was startled...
Oh, it's that kid from before...
entries.い、いやぁ・・・\nやっと、ここから出してもらえてさぁ・・・\nけ、けっして ぬ:
I, no...
Finally, I've been let out of here...
I, I didn't escape at all...
Well then, I'll be going now...
entries.よぉ・・・お前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・\nどうだい?オレと ひとしょうぶしな:
Hey… I was waiting for you to come…
How about it? Want to hang out with me?
entries.じつは、この先の高見ヤグラのてっぺんに\nある宝をかくしておいたんだ\n\nそこ:
Actually, I've hidden a treasure at the very top of Takami Yagura ahead.
So, starting from the bottom of Takami Yagura,
if you reach the treasure faster than me,
I'll give that treasure to you...

How about it, doesn't sound interesting?
entries.はぁ・・・はぁ・・・\nお前さん はやいなぁ・・・\n\nしょうがない、オレのま:
Haa... haa...
You're fast, aren't you...

It can't be helped, it's my defeat...
I'll give that treasure to you...
entries.いやぁ、ひさしぶりに\nたのしかったゼ\n・・・じゃあ、アバヨ!:
Wow, it's been a while since I had fun...
Well then, bye!
entries.ん? なんだい、くやしそうなカオだな・・・\nまぁ、オレはどうせ ヒマだからな・:
Hmm? What's wrong? You look frustrated...
Well, I'm just bored anyway...

If you ever want to try again,
feel free to talk to me anytime.
entries.よし! リトライだな・・・\nじゃあ、下におりようか・・・:
Alright! Time for a retry...
Well then, let's go down...
entries.あの鳥、ケガしてるみたいで\nあそこからおりられないんだ:
That bird seems to be injured,
and it can't get down from there.
entries.あの鳥、\nもどってきちゃったね:
That bird,
it came back, didn't it?
entries.このさき嵐の山・・・\n\nいつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・\nわし、:
This mountain ahead...

It's always windy, a very dangerous mountain...
I'm watching here, as told by the elder...
...but it's very boring...

So, I always practice here.
Huh? What kind of practice?

...Actually, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practice is very difficult...
What kind of face will make everyone feel...
entries.おおっ!そのカオ、\nそのひょうじょう・・・とてもいい!!\n\n・・・なるほど:
Oh! That Kao,
that hyojou... very good!!

...I see
...Hmm hmm
...Hmm, it will become very sankou.
entries.・・・う〜ん\n・・・でも、まだ何か足りない・・・\n\nたとえば・・・\n人に:
...Hmm...
...But something is still missing...

For example...
To convey sadness to people,
what kind of kao should I do?...
entries.ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!\nそ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・\n・・・:
Huh?... Whoa!
That, that Kaoshi filled with love! ...
...I see...

I mastered the laughter from earlier and the crying from now...
Hmm... hmm...
...nnn

I saw it!!
Yeah! Thanks!!

I feel like I can grasp something thanks to you!
Oops, I can't stay like this.
...From now on, it's over!!
entries.おっと、わすれてた・・・\nさっき、長老、山の方へ入っていった・・・\n\n何で:
Oops, I forgot...
Just now, the elder went towards the mountains...

Apparently, he has something to say to you...
You should go quickly.
entries.立ち入り禁止\nこの森には怪物がすんでいます。\n\nキケンですので立ち入らない:
No entry allowed.
This forest is inhabited by monsters.

Please do not enter as it is dangerous.
Bacchus Village Nature Conservation Office.
entries.おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・\n花のナミダ、めぐみさまの復活にかかせない・・:
I came to collect the flower tears...
The flower tears, they are essential for Megumi-sama's revival...

But...
I don't know how to collect the tears...
entries.高見ヤグラの下のほう、\n木でできてるところ・・・\n\nこわれやすいから\n気:
The lower part of the Takami Yagura,
the part made of wood...

It's fragile, so you should be careful...
entries.あの、まんなかにいるのが\nめぐみコゾウさまたち・・・\nでも、うごかない・・・:
Um, the ones in the middle are Megumi Kozo and the others...
But they don't move...
entries.めぐみさまが復活し、\n動きはじめるとき・・・\n何かがおこるといわれてる・・・:
When Megumi-sama revives and begins to move...
it's said that something will happen...
entries.ここ、めぐみの広場・・・\n魔ブタの魔法さえとければ、\nもっとキレイなところ・:
Here, Megumi's Square...
If only I could remove the magic of the demon pig,
there would be a more beautiful place...
entries.キノコの森には\n怪物がすんでるというウワサ・・・\n気をつけたほうがいい・・・:
There's a rumor that a monster lives in the mushroom forest...
You should be careful...
entries.そう言えば、めぐみさまの\n動いてるところ・・・\nだれも見たことない・・・: Come to think of it, no one has ever seen Megumi-sama's moving…
entries.わし、きょうは村の\n地下ロウの見はり当番・・・\n\nあれ?これ、\nないしょ:
Today, I'm on watch duty in the village's underground passage...

Huh? Wasn't this supposed to be a secret??
entries.この森も、昔はキレイな花が\nいっぱい咲いてた・・・\nこれもみんな、魔ブタのせ:
This forest too used to be full of beautiful flowers...
But now, it's all because of the demon pigs...
entries.魔ブタのかくれ家、\n目には見えないらしい・・・\n\nでも、入口は\nどこかに:
The devil pig's hideout,
it seems invisible to the eye...

But, the entrance must be somewhere...
entries.ここは・・・もう知ってるよね・・・: You already know this place, right?
entries.バッカスの湖にある水は、\nぜんぶアルコール・・・\n\nよっぱらうから、\n気:
The water in Lake Bacchus is all alcohol...

Because it's intoxicating, you should be careful...
entries.めぐみさまを復活させるには\nなにかが必要らしい・・・\n\nえ〜と・・・\nど:
It seems like something is needed to revive Megumi-sama...

Um...
I forgot...
entries.ん?・・・\nめぐみさまを復活させるもの?\n\n・・・そういえば、なにかの\n:
Hmm?...
Something to revive Megumi-sama?

...Come to think of it, something
requires tears...
entries.めぐみコゾウさま、\n人気者・・・みんな、\nこの広場にあつまってくる:
Megumi Kozo-sama,
Popular... everyone,
gathers in this square.
entries.嵐の山にも魔ブタの魔法が\nかかっているらしい・・・\n封印ぶくろ、どこかにある:
It seems the magic of the demon pig is also on the stormy mountain...
The sealed bag must be somewhere...
entries.ときどき、森の地面の下から、\nものおとがきこえてくる・・・\nちょっとコワイ・:
Sometimes, from under the forest floor,
I hear footsteps...
It's a little scary...
entries.シーフマンション、\nたくさんの小部屋がある\n\n・・・全部見たか?\n・・・:
Seaf Mansion,
there are many small rooms.

...Have you seen them all?
...It's tough though...
entries.この先のリーフスライダーをぬけて、\nキノコの森を左に行けば、\n近道がある・・:
Go past the leaf slider ahead,
and if you go left through the mushroom forest,
there's a shortcut...
entries.キノコの森のむこうがわには、\nバッカスの村と湖がある・・・: Beyond the mushroom forest lies the village of Bacchus and a lake...
entries.1000年の宝箱に いどうにべんりな\nグルピン かくされているらしい・・・: It seems a convenient Gurupin is hidden in the 1000-year treasure chest...
entries.なかま・・・みつかっていない・・・\nここからさきは いかないほうがいい:
I haven't found my companion...
It's better not to go any further from here.
entries.ドワーフのこども 迷子になった・・・\nもりのおくへ いかないように\nみはって:
A dwarf child got lost...
Don't go deep into the forest.
It's spreading...
entries.よぉ!びっくりしたかい?\n・・・オレは、カレハチョウを集めてるんだ・・・:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting butterflies...
entries.ウワサによると、\nカレハチョウにはふしぎな力があって・・・\n何匹か集めるとス:
According to rumors,
the butterfly has mysterious powers...
Apparently, if you gather several of them, something amazing happens...
entries.何がおこるか、もし見たいんだったら、\nつかまえた カレハチョウを\nこのムシカ:
If you want to see what happens,
put the butterfly I caught inside this mug.
entries.なんだ・・・\nもうもってたのか・・・:
What...
Did you already have it...?
entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今・・・\n00匹ぐらいだな・・:
Hii... fuu... mi...
The butterflies are now...
About 00 or so...
entries.今回のバージョンは、ここまでです。\nこの先のエリアに進むと\nゲームは自動的に:
This version ends here.
If you proceed to the next area,
the game will automatically end.
entries.ありゃりゃ・・・もう見つかっちゃった\n・・・よーし、つぎで しょうぶだ!:
Oh dear... I've already been found.
...Alright, next up is the iris!
entries.・・・おっ、やっと気がついたかい\n・・・いやぁ、ひどい目にあったなぁ\n\n・:
...Oh, finally you've noticed?
...Wow, I got into a terrible situation.

...Just when I thought I'd been flying through the sky for a while,
the insect cage fell apart mid-flight...

Before I knew it, I was dropped into this place...
entries.やめた、やめた!・・・\n何が伝説のカレハチョウだよ・・・\n\nあんたも あき:
Stopped, stopped!...
What's this legendary swallowtail butterfly...?

You should give up too, you know.
...Huh? A butterfly?... Oh,

If it's a swallowtail butterfly, they're gathering around those egg-like things over there.
Seriously, what was that all about...?

Well then, I'm off now... wait, where am I?
entries.始まりの村で、サンタとかいう\nサルみかけた・・・\nはらへって動けないとかなん:
In the starting village, I saw something like Santa...
It looked like a monkey...
I was hungry and couldn't move, or something like that...
entries.トンバも めぐみコゾウさま 見にきたか?\n・・・きっといいことある・・・\nた:
Tonba too, Megumi Kozou-sama, did you come to see?
...I'm sure something good will happen...
Probably...
entries.マグマのどうくつも\n魔ブタの魔法かかってる\n\n・・・炎けすには\n魔ブタを:
The magma's clouds too
are under the spell of the demon pig's magic.

...To extinguish the flames,
we must seal the demon pig...
entries.シーフマンション・・・むかし、\nとうぞくの すみかだったところ・・・:
Seaf Mansion… once,
it was a place where the Touzoku lived…

Hii... fuu... mi...
There's probably about one butterfly now...
entries.知ってるか?・・・キノコの森には\nひとつのキノコで泣いたり、\n笑ったりできる:
Do you know? ...In the mushroom forest,
there seems to be one mushroom that can make you cry,
or laugh.

...I haven't seen it myself, though.
entries.このおく・・・地面がすべり台みたいになってる・・・\nみんな、リーフスライダーと:
This... the ground looks like a slide...
Everyone calls it the Reef Slider, but...

It's a little dangerous... so,
I can't let you pass here... crying won't help...
entries.お・・・おい・・・\nほんとうに泣いてるのか\n\n・・・いや・・・\nあれは:
O... hey...
Are you really crying?

...No...
That was just a parable...

Okay... I'll let you through,
so don't cry anymore...
entries.わし、むかし じいさんから\nふしぎな話聞いた・・・\n\n赤い花に・・・粉をか:
I once heard a strange story from my grandfather...
When you sprinkle powder on a red flower...
it turns blue... when red and blue clash,
... um... also,

I forgot...
entries.◎のコ□バ・・・\n○にを◎△て○ん●かな・・・:
The ◎ of □...
I wonder if ○ can be ◎△ed to become ○n●...
entries.ここは・・・恵みの広場!\n\n・・・ほんとーの、恵みの広場!!:
This is... the Square of Blessings!

...Truly, the Square of Blessings!!
entries.森も、もとにもどった\n\n・・・あとは\n恵みさまの復活を待つばかり・・・:
The forest has also returned to its original state...

...All that remains is to wait for the revival of Eimi-sama...
entries.ドワーフ、\nトンバを おうえんしてる・・・\n\nおうえんだけだけど・・・:
Dwarf,
I'm cheering for Tomba...

Just cheering though...
entries.トンバ、つよい!\nわし、よわい・・・\n\n恵みさま、エライ!\nわし、エラク:
Tonba, strong!
I am weak...

Emi-sama, great!
I am not great...

Tohoho...
entries.ここは・・・恵みの広場!\nしかもミリオンの塔つき!!:
This is... the Plaza of Blessings!
And it even comes with a Million Tower!!
entries.恵みさま・・・\n2人だけ のこった・・・:
Emi-sama...
Only the two of us remained...
entries.これがウワサに聞く ミリオンの塔!\nでも、どうやって入る?:
This is the Million Tower, as rumored!
But how do you get in?
entries.恵みさま スゴイ!\n・・・ちいさな芽が\nこんなに大きくなった!:
Emi-sama, amazing!
...a tiny bud
has grown so big!
entries.この上・・・一体 何があるのか?\n・・・・・・とっても気になる・・・:
What on earth is up there?
...I'm really curious...
entries.ハハハ・・・ビックリしたかい?\n\nこの塔に 入りたいんだったら\nたくさんA:
Hahaha... Were you surprised?

If you want to enter this tower,
you need to gather a lot of AP!
entries.こうやってないと・・・\nミリオンの塔が\nまたしぼんじゃうんだ・・・:
If I don't do this...
The Million Tower will
shrink again...
entries.なんだい?\nオイラのべんとうを 持って来てくれたのか・・・\n\nそう・・・と:
What is it?
Did you bring my bento...?

So... did Dad make it?
But I'm not hungry right now,
so you can eat the bento...

Ah! Oh, I'll give you this too. See you later.
entries.え? とうさんから\nあずかった べんとう\n食べちゃったの・・・\n\nう〜ん:
Huh? I ate the bento my dad gave me...
Hmm, well, whatever,
if you enjoyed it, then that's good.

Well, I'm off... See ya later!

entries.わし、けっこうアタマいい\nおまえのコトバわかる・・・けど、\nおまえ、ドワーフ:
I'm pretty smart.
I understand your words... but
you don't understand dwarven words...

If you bite into our words,
you'll remember them...
It might take more than once though...
entries.コ○バ・・・\nわ○○○ない・・・:
Ko-ba...
I don't have a wa-wa-wa...
entries.な○とか ひ△しで\n◎●てきた・・・: I've been doing ◎● with な○ or ひ△...
entries.目のまえで、なかま\nいなくなった・・・: Right before my eyes, my comrade disappeared...
entries.どうしようかねぇ・・・\nあれがないと こまるんだけどねぇ\n・・・おや、きいて:
What should I do...?
I'm in trouble if I don't have that...
...Oh, were you listening?

...Actually... I hid something important in the forest,
but...

There are so many Komabuta in the forest right now,
so I can't go get it...
It's a very important thing though...
entries.森の中に だいじなものを\nかくしておいたんだけど・・・\n\n今の森には、コマ:
I hid something important in the forest,
but...

There are so many Komabuta in the forest now,
so I can't go get it...
It's such an important thing though...
entries.おやっ!これ、\nとってきてくれたのかい?\nうれしいねぇ・・・\n\nえんりょ:
Oh! Did you bring this for me?
I'm so happy...

I'll eat it without hesitation.
...Here it comes! Here it comes!
entries.・・・ふうーーーっ\n\nじつは、おなかの中に\nガスがたまってて\nくるしかっ:
...Fuuu

Actually, inside my stomach.
There's gas buildup.
It was painful.

Thanks to you, I was saved.
...Thank you.

...That's right, well.
I don't understand.

...instead, this.
Please take it...

It seems to be a rare thing.
entries.この先、消さない・・・\nこれ わしのしごと・・・:
I won't erase this from now on...
This is my work...
entries.ん?なんだ、おまえ\nこれ欲しいのか?\n\n・・・先、あぶないから\nきをつけ:
Hmm? What is it, you?
Do you want this?

...It's dangerous ahead, so
Be careful and take it...
entries.お〜い・・・ だれかいないかぁ〜\n・・・あかりがきれたぞぉ〜:
Hey... Is anyone there?
...The lights are out!
entries.こども!・・・こども見なかったか?\n\nこども、高見ヤグラに 花のたね\nさが:
Child! ... Didn't you see the child?

The child went to Takami Yagura to look for flower seeds... and hasn't come back!

Worried, worried...
Very worried...
entries.・・・あと6人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...six more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと5人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...five more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと4人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...four more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと3人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...Three more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あと2人、\nかえってこない・・・:
...two more people,
they won't come back...
entries.・・・あとひとりだけ、\nかえってこない・・・:
...just one more person,
who hasn't come back...
entries.おお!おまえ、こども、たすけてくれたか!\n\nおまえ、とてもやさしいこころもっ:
Oh! You, child, did you help me!

You have a very kind heart... I am very happy.

Take this with you, it will surely be useful.
entries.こども見つけてくれて\nありがとう・・・\nわしとおまえ、ともだち:
Thank you for finding me...
You and I, we're friends.
entries.この花だんにお花咲かせたいなぁ・・・\n\nちょっと前までは、\n森にたくさんの:
I wish I could make flowers bloom in this flowerbed...

Just a little while ago,
there were so many seeds in the forest...

But now they've all withered...

I don't think it's just the evil pig's fault...
entries.もう、お花見れないのかなぁ・・・: I wonder if I'll never be able to see cherry blossoms again...
entries.おまえ、APと書かれた\nへんなモノ見たか?: Did you see something weird that said AP?
entries.わしらのなかま、あれと同じ\nマークの入った箱やリングも\n見たこと、あるらしい: It seems our comrades have also seen boxes and rings with the same mark…
entries.どうすれば、ひらくか?\n・・・気になる・・・:
How can I open it?
...I'm curious...
entries.くわしいはなし、ひろばにいる\nなかまがしってる・・・:
Detailed information is available on the forum.
My friends know...
entries.おお、おまえ、\nドワーフのことばわかるか!?\nドワーフ、とてもこまってる\n:
Oh, you,
do you understand the Dwarves' language!?
The Dwarves are very troubled.

...Actually...
This Dwarven forest,
is under the magic of the Demon Pig...

The flowers and trees have also changed their appearance…

Just now, seven companions were
surrounded by monsters in the forest
and their fate became unknown…

Probably, they're inside a large monster
or possessed by a ghost
and can't move…

Hurry up and open the door near the entrance to the village
and the hut in the forest,
then go deep into the forest, to the edge.

...If you can't find your companions,
they won't let you pass through the forest…
entries.なかま見つからないと、\n森のおく\nとおしてくれないはず・・・:
If you can't find your friends,
they won't let you through the forest...
entries.おお・・・なかま、\nぜんいん助けてくれたか・・・\nほんとうにありがとう:
Oh... comrades,
did you all help me...?
Thank you very much.
entries.ドワーフの長老、\nとてもよろこんでる・・・\nはなし きいてみるといい:
The dwarf elder,
is very pleased...
you should listen to the story.
entries.・・・7人のなかま、\nかえってきたけど\n\n・・・じつは、\nこどもがひとり:
...Seven companions,
have returned,

...but actually,
one child...

remained lost in the forest...
entries.おまえ、とても、ゆうきある\nドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする:
You, very, have courage.
Dwarf, you, are scared.
entries.勇気ある少年よ・・・\nわしがドワーフの\n長老ですじゃ・・・:
A brave boy...
I am the elder of the dwarves...
entries.7人のドワーフは\nかえってきたんじゃが・・・\n\n子どもがまだ\nかえってこ:
The seven dwarfs
have returned...

But the children
haven't come back yet...
entries.子どもの両親は、この集落の\n入口のちかくの家におる・・・\n話をきいてくれんか:
The child's parents live in a house near the entrance of this village…
Will you listen to what I have to say?
entries.村人全表になりかわり、\n礼を言わせてほしい・・・\n\nなかまをたすけてくれて:
I'd like to express my gratitude on behalf of the villagers...

Thank you so much for helping my comrades...

Since this is such a small village,
I can't offer much in return...

...That's right...
I heard a story from a 100-year-old man,

that he was watching over the fate of the demon pig...
entries.おぉ、あったあった、\nこれじゃ・・・:
Oh, there it is,
this is...
entries.これは、この森に魔法をかけた魔ブタの\n封印ぶくろ ですじゃ・・・\n\nこれが:
This is the Seal Pouch of the magical pig that cast magic on this forest...

With this, simply approaching where the magical pig is hiding should lead you to the entrance to its hiding place—the Magical Pig Gate...
entries.でも、魔ブタ、\n自分が魔法をかけた場所には\nかくれない・・・:
But the demon pig,
it doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...
entries.それに、魔ブタにはそれぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあり、\n1匹づつ封印できる\n\:
Moreover, each demon pig has its own sealing bag, allowing you to seal them one at a time.
...In other words, you need seven sealing bags for seven demon pigs.
entries.ふくろ、\n魔法をかけられた場所の\nちかくに必ずあるハズ・・・:
A bag,
near the place where magic was cast,
should definitely be there…
entries.魔ブタのゆくえを知りたいのなら、\nそれぞれの 封印ぶくろ をさがすことが\n一:
If you want to know where the Demon Pig is headed,
searching for each of its sealed pouches would be the most direct approach...

But... the Demon Pig's power is immense...
Don't try to force it...

You won't need to look deep into the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...
entries.そうじゃな・・・まずは\n大トリの山へ行ってみなされ\n\n・・・あそこも昔は\:
That's right... first,
why don't you go to the mountain of the big bird?

...that place used to be a quiet mountain too...

But then that storm... surely
the magic of the demon pig
is cast on it...
entries.魔ブタ・・・\n自分が魔法をかけた場所にはかくれない・・・\n\n封印ぶくろあれ:
Magic pig...
It doesn't hide in places where I cast magic...

If I had a sealing bag,
I could find the magic pig gate...

But each magic pig has
its own sealing bag,
and I can seal them one by one...

In other words, for seven magic pigs,
I need seven sealing bags...

The bag should definitely be near the place where the magic was cast...
entries.ドワーフ、木を切るのとくい・・・\n\nおまえ、わしら助けてくれた・・・\nだか:
Dwarves are skilled at cutting trees...

You helped us...
So if you ever get into trouble,
you should ask one of our comrades...
entries.ん・・・木を切ってほしいのか?\n\nでも、ドワーフが切るのは\nやくめをおえた:
Hmm... do you want me to cut down the tree?

But dwarves only cut down old trees...

For now, I'll follow you...
entries.・・・うん、この木ならだいじょうぶ・・・\nじゃあ、すこしさがって まってろ・・:
...Yeah, this tree will be fine...
Then, go back a little and wait...
entries.おや、あんたも長老をさがしてるのかい?\nこまったねぇ・・・\n\n実は、村のド:
Oh, are you also looking for an elder?
This is troublesome...

Actually, two dwarves in the village have started fighting...
Normally I would just leave it alone, but...

And of all places, they're standing guard at the entrance to the village,
so I can't get out anymore...

...Could you stop them?
entries.長老がいたら、\n一発でおさめてくれるのにねぇ・・・:
If there was an elder,
he would put an end to it in one shot…
entries.うまく かくしたから だいじょうぶ!\n\nそんなの すぐに見つかる・・・\n\:
I wrote it well, so it's okay!

That kind of thing will be found quickly…

After all, I should apologize!
entries.あの2人、長老から\n何かあずかってたらしい・・・: It seems those two received something from the elder…
entries.ほ、ほら・・・やっぱり見つかった!\n\nおまえがわるい!\n\nいや、こわした:
Ho, ho... I found it after all!

It's your fault!

No, you broke it!
entries.ぶわっかもーん!!\nわしの大事なつぼを\nこわすとはなにごとゃ!:
Bwah! What's going on?!
You dare to break my precious pot?!
entries.ふぅ・・・やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・\nおまえさん悪いがこの穴をうめといて:
Phew... I finally managed to get out of this hole...
Sorry, but could you fill this hole back up?

...But who on earth dug this hole anyway...?

...Hmm? What's going on? It's getting noisy outside...
Just as a side note,
...Hey, could you go take a look?
entries.ふぅ・・・おまえさんがなかなか来ないから、\nいちど村にもどってきたんじゃが、\:
Hmm... since you haven't come back for so long,
I returned to the village once,
but I got stuck in this hole splendidly...

Finally, I managed to get out of the hole...

...You,
could you please fill this hole for me?

...But who would dig such a hole...

I'll be waiting in the mountains again...
so don't make me wait too long...
entries.・・・・・・あぁ!お前は!\nぬけ方をふさいじまったガキじゃねえか!\n\n・・:
...Ah! You're!
A kid who started blocking the way out!

...Good grief...
I was about to escape while the dwarves were distracted,
but they blocked the exit right in front of me...

Thanks to that, I'm back in this mess again...
Like a fool...
entries.これじゃぁ屋敷の宝物どころか\nパン一切れさえぬすめやしねえ・・・\n\nそうだ:
This isn't even worth calling a treasure of the mansion—
I can't even steal a single slice of bread...

That's right! ...You know about Takami Yagura's
bounkyo...?

Ah... no...
It's nothing special...

Damn, this is boring... Alright!
...I'll sulk!
entries.すぴ〜すかかか・・・んがんごっ・・・\n・・・・・すぴょぴょぴょ・・・・・\n\:
Supi~ sukaka ka... ngan go...
...Supyo pyo pyo pyo...

Uun... buen kyo wa...
Takami Yagura no... yane no ue...

Munyamunya... sore o... bo no ue ni...
Toritsukete... supyo pyo pyo pyo...
entries.おや、かわいいボウヤだね。\nでも見たところ元気そうじゃないか・・・\n\nわた:
Oh, what a cute little boy.
But from the looks of it, he seems fine...

I may look like this, but I'm a doctor,
so come see me again if you get hurt.
entries.ボウヤ・・・\nわたしゃこう見えても\nいそがしいんだよ・・・:
Boy...
Even though I look like this,
I'm busy...
entries.みんなを助けてくれたんだって?\nけっこうやるじゃないか・・・ありがとね:
I heard you helped everyone?
You're pretty good at this... thank you.
entries.あんたがケガしたら\nまっ先に見てあげるからね: If you get hurt, I'll be the first to check on you.
entries.おや、どうしたんだいその小鳥・・・\nケガしてるじゃないか!\nちょっと見せてご:
Oh, what's wrong with that little bird...
It's injured!
Let me take a look.

・・・・・・・・・・
・・・This will take a while, huh...

Boy, I'll take care of this little bird for a while...
Don't worry,
I'll take care of it.

・・・Ah, what's the name of this bird?
・・・?
What... at least give it a name...

・・・・・・Baron?・・・I see, Baron.
・・・What a good name!
entries.しばらくしたら また、\n見に来ておくれ: Please come see me again soon.
entries.おまえ、森の外出るのか?\nだったら一度、近道行ってみるといい\n\nとてもキレ:
Are you going outside the forest?
If so, you should try taking a shortcut once.

It's very beautiful... and you can also see a large mansion in the distance.
...Eh? Is there treasure in the mansion?

...But... you can't go to the amusement park unless you get on a boat...
entries.・・・そういえば、むかし、\n近から このむらに、魔王きたことある・・・\n\n:
...Come to think of it, a long time ago,
the Demon King came to this village from near...

A mysterious crystal in the forest, apparently something the Demon King forgot...
entries.おまえ、ともだち・・・\nまたあそびにこい:
You, my friend...
Come play again.
entries.おにいちゃん!おにいちゃん!\n・・・お花が咲いたんだよ!:
Big brother! Big brother!
...Flowers have bloomed!
entries.そ○の◎◎の◎◎・・・◎◎に\nつな○△てる・・・もう◎△たか?: That ○○'s ○○... ○○ is connected... Is it already ○○?
entries.◎の◎はあ●ないよ・・・: The ◎ of the ◎ doesn't have a ●...
entries.わ○ら、○ても◎△て○: I'm sorry, but I can't help with that.
entries.森の中、とてもあぶない\n・・・ぜったいダメ!: In the forest, it's very dangerous... absolutely no!
entries.そこの右側の入口・・・\n長老の家につながってる\n\n・・・でも、今みんな\n:
The entrance on the right side over there...
It leads to the elder's house.

...But everyone is busy now...
entries.おおっ! コトバ少し おぼえたか・・・\nでも、まだ かんぜんには わからない\:
Oh! Did you remember a few words...?
But I still don't understand completely.

...Also, if I bite someone alone,
I think I can remember the words...
entries.ここ、ドワーフの村\n・・・なかまいなくなって\nおおさわぎ・・・:
Here, the dwarven village.
...it's no longer worth mentioning.
A great commotion...
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\nなかま、いなくなった!\n\nいま、みんなで 森にある小:
Oh no! Oh no!
My friend is gone!

Right now, everyone is opening the door near the entrance to the village and the cabin in the forest,

and we went looking for the rickety pier and the Takami Yagura...
entries.なかま、木にとりついた\nホウシにつかまって\n木にぶらさがってた・・・\n\n:
A companion, clinging to the tree,
Holding onto a fern,
Hanging from the tree...

When hanging, the fern stretches out
...It's very suspicious...
entries.なかまのこと・・・\nとてもしんぱい:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\n何がたいへんって、\nそりゃーもーたいへん!:
Oh dear! Oh dear!
What's so terrible?
Oh my, it's absolutely terrible!
entries.この小屋のこども、\nまだかえってこないらしい:
The child in this hut,
seems to still not have returned.
entries.封印ぶくろ?・・・そういえば、\n森の封印ぶくろとかいうもの\nちょうろうがもっ:
Seal gloves? ... Speaking of which,
there's something called seal gloves in the forest.
Chorou has them...
entries.おまえ、友だち・・・\nまぁ、ゆっくりしていけ:
You, friend...
Well, take your time.
entries.森で、へんなイヌ見た・・・\nおまえ見たか?:
I saw a strange dog in the forest...
Did you see it?
entries.あのイヌ、\nケガしてたんだってな・・・:
That dog,
I heard it was injured...
entries.森の中で こども\n見なかったか?: Didn't you see the child in the forest?
entries.森の中にある めぐみの広場\n・・・もう行ったか?:
Megumi's Square in the forest...
...Have you been there yet?
entries.わし・・・\nつかまえた大ドロボウ 見はってる\n\n・・・ん?どこにいるか?・:
I...
I'm watching the big thief I caught.

...Hmm? Where is he?...
...I can't tell you that...
entries.なかま たすけてくれた\n・・・ありがとう: My friend helped me... thank you.
entries.そう言えば・・・\n始まりの森のかみつき草にも\n花が咲くらしい・・・\n\nで:
Come to think of it...
I hear flowers bloom on the biting grass in the forest of beginnings...

But we've never seen them...
entries.キノコの森を右側にぬけた先に\n山がある・・・でも、\nとてもキケンな山・・・: Beyond the mushroom forest on the right lies a mountain... but it's a very dangerous one...
entries.キノコの森には、\nいろんなキノコはえてるけど\nむやみに食べない方がいい:
In the mushroom forest,
there are various mushrooms growing,
but it's better not to eat them recklessly.
entries.高見ヤグラのぼうえんきょう、もう見たか?\nあそこのけしき、とてもキレイ・・・:
Have you seen the Noboru Kyo of Takami Yagura yet?
That scenery over there is very beautiful...
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・\nちょっとたいへん・・・:
I... I'm a lookout...
It's a little difficult...
entries.わしらの◎◎、いなくな△た・・・\n◎は◎に◎ないほう●いい・・・:
Our ◎◎ has disappeared…
It's better if ◎ doesn't exist…
entries.わしらのなかま、いなくなった・・・\n今は森に出ないほうがいい・・・:
Our comrades have disappeared…
It's better not to go into the forest now…
entries.わしらの長老にはもう会ったか?: Have you met our elder yet?
entries.たき先といえば・・・\n・・・・・・ヤキイモだねぇ・・・\n\nそういえば、\n:
Speaking of firewood...
...It's yakiimo, huh...

Come to think of it,
there's a nice smell in the forest, you know...
entries.おやっ!\n・・・これ、くれるのかい?\nうれしいねぇ・・・\n\nそうだ、何か:
Oh!
...Is this what you're giving me?
I'm so happy...

Well, I don't really understand what's going on, but...
Please take this instead.
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅう・・・ぜんぶ見たか?:
Hanging from a sharp tree.
Houshi manju... Have you seen them all?
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅうの中に\nなかま2人 とりこまれ:
Hanging from a sharp tree,
inside a hōshi manju,
two companions were captivated.
entries.ユラユラゆれるホウシダマ・・・\nとてもあやしい・・・:
The swaying fern...
It's very suspicious...
entries.ホウシダマがかぶさっている\n木の上のなかま、2人いるハズ・・・:
The houjidama is overlapping.
There should be two people among the trees...
entries.グラグラさんばしに なかまひとり\nつかまってた・・・: I was caught by Guragura-sanbashi, with one companion.
entries.高見ヤグラ・・・ひろくてたいへん\n・・・なかま見つけにくい・・・\n回転する液:
Takami Yagura... It's wide and difficult.
... It's hard to find companions...
Rotating liquid, you have to use it skillfully...
entries.たしか高見ヤグラに2人のなかま\nつかまっているハズ: I'm sure there are two of them trapped in Takami Yagura.
entries.たき先といえば・・・・・・\nヤキイモだねぇ・・・:
Speaking of the tip...
It's a yakimo, huh...
entries.こども・・・森から\nまだかえってこないらしい・・・:
Children... from the forest.
It seems they haven't returned yet...
entries.そういえば、高見ヤグラで\nこどものこえ きこえたような・・・:
Come to think of it, at Takami Yagura,
I think I heard a child's voice...
entries.ドワーフの長老、\nとても よろこんでる:
The dwarf elder,
is very pleased.
entries.あくしゅ してほしい・・・: I want you to shake hands...
entries.・・・うわぁっ!!!\n・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・\n\nなんだ、いつか:
...Whoa!!!
...B-...I was startled...

Oh, it's that kid from before...
N-no...
Finally, I've been let out of here...

N-no, I didn't sneak out or anything...
Well then, I'll be going now...
entries.あれ、APボックスとかいうらしい・・・\nわしらでは ひらくこと\nできないけど:
Hmm, it seems to be called an AP box...
We can't open it, though...
entries.なにか、かんじましたかな・・・\n\nおまえさんが いまかんじた\n「嵐の山の怪:
Did you feel something...?

The "Mountain Monster" you just sensed—that's where magic has been cast on this mountain.

...If you ever feel something new in the future,
that place is where magic has been applied...

In other words, it's the hidden location of the sealed bag...

Identifying the magically enchanted area is the key to discovering the sealed bag...
entries.・・・おっ・・・ぬけ穴が見えた\n・・・ありがてぇ・・・これでやっと\nぬけだせ:
...Oh...I see a loophole.
...Thank you...With this, I can finally escape.
I can finally get out...Goodbye!
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・ん?\n何の見はりか?\n・・・・・それはおしえられない:
I... watch... hmm?
What kind of watch?
...I can't tell you that.
entries.ケガを早く治すのに「ナオリ草」があれば\nいいんだけど・・・\n\nあれがあるの:
It would be nice if there were "Naori grass" to heal injuries quickly...

I think that's on the mountain of the big bird, right?

But
that place is windy and dangerous, so no...
entries.あらっ! ナオリ草じゃないか\n\nあんた 大トリの山まで 取りに行ったのかい!:
Oh! It's Naori grass!

Did you go all the way to the mountain for the big bird!?
You were lucky to be safe.

But this will help Baron's injury heal faster.
entries.あとは おいしいものでも たべさせて\nゆっくりしとけば 元気になるさ・・・\n:
After that, let's have something delicious to eat.
If we just relax, we'll feel better...

Oh, speaking of delicious things, "Hyakushiki no Kinami"!
I once ate it too, and it was really tasty.

I want to eat it again...
entries.まぁ! これは百識の木の実じゃないか\nあたしにくれるのかい?\n\n・・・・え:
Oh! Isn't this the fruit of the Hundred Knowledge Tree?
Are you giving it to me?

...Eh!? To Baron?...
That's right.
I have to cheer up Baron now.

Yes! Baron!
Eat this and get well...
entries.ところで このごろ\nバロンを見てて思うんだけど\n\nこのバロンは\nなんか:
By the way, lately
I've been thinking about Baron

This Baron
seems to have some kind of mysterious power,
don't you think?

Look! His ears are so big, right?
For example,
he could fly through the sky with these...

For example—for example!
But when I look at Baron,
it makes me feel that way.

Well, for now, I just need to get better quickly.
After that, it's a surprise!
entries.とにかく これで だいじょうぶ\nあとはあたしに まかせておきな\n\nまた ち:
Anyway, this should be fine.
Just leave it to me from now on.

Come show your face again soon, okay?

Baron will be happy too...
entries.そうそう あんた\n始まりの村にある屋敷のウラの\n浜道に行くことあるかい?\n:
Hey, you
Do you ever go to the beach road behind the mansion in the starting village?

Every year around this time,
waves always wash up on the shore there,
but...

This "near grass" is good for your health,
and it doesn't cause illness either.

I want everyone to stay healthy,
so I go get some every year,
but this year I don't think I'll be able to go.
If you happen to go,
could you bring some back for me?
entries.ねェ それはそうと\nバロン 少しおおきくなったように\n思わないかい?\n\n:
Hey, speaking of which,
Baron, don't you think he's gotten a little bigger?
Is he growing fast?
Or is it just my imagination...?
entries.ありがとう\nこれで今年もみんな元気ですごせるよ\n\nところで ごらん、バロン:
Thank you.
With this, everyone can spend this year energetically.

By the way, look, Baron.
He's grown so big!
He really grows fast.

When you brought him here,
he was quite weak, but

he's become so big now.
He's completely fine!
entries.あらっ?!\nバロンはあんたといっしょに行きたい\nみたいだねェ\n\nつれてっ:
Oh?!
Baron wants to go with you.
It seems like it.

Don't take him.
entries.なんか 背中にのれって言ってるよ\nのってあげな\nバロンも うれしいんだよ\n:
It's saying "Get on my back" on my back.
Get on it.
Baron is happy too.

Well then, see you later.
Come again if you get hurt.

I'll heal you.
Both of you stay healthy.

entries.いやぁ、たすかったよ・・・\nオレは中央センターの者なんだけど、\n自分で湖まで:
Wow, I was saved...
I'm from the Central Center, but
I tried to go to the lake myself and ended up like this.

...Seriously... I even brought the key for the small room...

...It's pathetic, but
I'll be returning to the village once...

Ah, if there's anything you don't understand,
come to me...
I'm at the Central Center.

You shouldn't push yourself too hard either...
entries.・・・なぁ、これ 何だとおもう?\n・・・何かフシギな絵だよなぁ\n\nなんか:
...Hey, what do you think this is?
...It's a strange picture, isn't it?

It looks like it's recessed somehow,
...but I wonder if it fits in...

...Come to think of it, I think there was a large keyhole in this building somewhere.

...Is there a connection...?
entries.・・・よく来た・・・と、\n言いたいところじゃが、\n\n見ての通り、とても話が:
...I'd like to say "Welcome," but...

As you can see, I'm not in a state where I can talk properly...

Well, I've caused quite a bit of trouble for them too...

That Komabuta guy locked me up in this place...
That's why...

I can't get out of here unless I steal the magical power of the thing sealing this room...
entries.すまんが、\nこの部屋の封印がとけてから、\nまた来てくれんか・・・:
Sorry,
but could you come again after the seal on this room melts…?
entries.おお、来たか・・・サスガじゃな、\n100年のヤツが言っておったことも\nまんざ:
Oh, you've come... As expected,
it seems what the 100-year-old said
isn't entirely a lie...

Hmm... It's about the Demon Pig, isn't it...
The Demon Pig uses very powerful magic...
Magic strong enough to change the area it dominates.

...But, to generate strong magical power,
a lot of gold is needed...
It seems a lot of gold is required...

They apparently gather it somewhere.

...If only we knew where that place is,
we could surely find the memento arm you're looking for...
entries.フム・・・・・・・・・\nおぬしはまだまだ強くなる・・・\nその探求心をなくさん:
Hmm...
You still have so much more to grow...
As long as you don't lose that spirit of inquiry...

First, try climbing to the sacred fire of the sun somewhere in this building...

From there, new paths will open up for you...
Find the rest with your own strength.
entries.・・・ホレ、わしからのプレゼント\n・・・1000年のカギじゃ・・・:
...Here, a present from me.
...It's the key to 1000 years...
entries.1000年カギで あけることができる\n1000年の宝箱には大トリの山の先・・・:
You can open it with the 1000-year key.
The 1000-year treasure chest is beyond the Great Tiger Mountain…

In other words, it contains something necessary to pass through the magma cave…

I think… it should be located on the Great Tiger Mountain.

However… technique is required to cross the cave…

After that, there's that flame in the magma cave…

Regarding this, there's no way to do anything unless you find and seal the pig that cast magic over there.

If you have Midori's sealing bag, you should be able to find the Pig Gate, so please search this place thoroughly…
entries.気を付けて行くんじゃぞ・・・\nそうじゃ・・・もう一度、大トリにのりたいのなら\:
Be careful when you go...
That's right... If you want to be the grand finale again,
try finding the favorite food of the grand finale...

I think it was something like... a flower or something...
Well then... see you later...
entries.ふぅ、なんとか たどりついたな\n・・・おれはここで待ってるから、\nよろしくな:
Phew, I somehow made it here.
...I'll be waiting here, so
please take care of things.

Ah...and also, the pump switch might be
broken, so please make sure to turn it on properly.
entries.すまないな・・・\nおれたちのちからでは\nうごかないんだ・・・:
I'm sorry...
With our strength,
it doesn't move...
entries.どうやら、なおったみたいだな・・・\nさぁ、いっしょにかえろうか・・・:
It seems like it's fixed...
Well, let's go home together...
entries.・・・ちょっとカンタンすぎたかな?\n・・・じゃあ、またな!:
...was it a little too easy?
...Well, see you later!
entries.そのべんとうは・・・とうさんに会ったんだね?\nわざわざ とどけてくれてありがと:
That bento... you met your dad, didn't you?
Thank you for taking the trouble to deliver it.
But I'll give this one to you.

I'm not hungry, so...
If you like, I can give you this too.
It's nothing special, though...

Well then, bye!
entries.え・・・な、なんだって!!\nオイラのべんとう 食べちゃったのか?\n\nオイオ:
Eh... what?!
Did you eat my bento?

Hey hey, it's just a joke...
You don't have to worry about it!
Dad's bento is delicious anyway!

Well then, I'm off... Bye-bye!
entries.いや〜じつはさぁ・・・また\nなくしちゃったんだわ・・・\n\nカシラに見つかる:
Oh no—actually... I've lost it again...

If Kashira finds me, I'm in trouble, so I'm hiding here.

It seems I must have left it somewhere earlier.

But if I come down from here now,
Kashira will find me, so I can't come down~

What should I do...?
entries.いやーさっきといい 今といい\nほんっとに ありがとう:
Wow, just like before, just like now.
Honestly, thank you.
entries.お礼といったら なんなんだが\nこれもらってくれや:
When it comes to thanks, what would you say?
Please take this.
entries.今のうちに これ\nカシラに返しとくわ\nそれっ!:
I'll return this to Kashira while I have the chance.
That!
entries.はぁ・・・こまったわねぇ・・・\nあんな滝のうえに あるなんて・・・\n\nどう:
Haa... what a mess...
It's on top of that waterfall...

What should I do... my necklace...
entries.・・・あらっ?・・・これは?\n・・・わたしの首飾り!\n\n・・・ひょっとして:
...Oh? ...What is this?
...My necklace!

...Could it be that you
brought it for me? ...I'm so happy!
entries.・・・えっ? 水の潜り方をおしえてほしい?\n・・・わかったわ わたしにまかせて:
...Huh? You want me to teach you how to dive?
...Okay, leave it to me!

...I'm just placing something under this water...

If you can retrieve that,
your dive will be perfect...
entries.まずは、水に入ってちょうだい: First, please get into the water.
entries.そうそう・・・そうやってると\n体が水に浮くでしょ・・・\n\nで、そこから潜る:
Yeah, yeah... if you do that,
your body will float in the water, right?

And then diving from there isn't
that difficult, is it...?

First... try pressing the directional key down...
entries.方向キーを下に押して\nあたまを下にむけるの:
Press the direction key downwards
and turn your head downwards.
entries.そう・・・そのちょうし・・・あとは\n行きたい方向のキーと×ボタンで\n水中を進:
So... that butterfly... after that,
you can move through the water using the directional keys and the × button.

After that,
please try your best to pick up what's left.
entries.どう?\nもう水中の潜りは\nカンペキでしょ?:
How about it?
Isn't diving underwater perfect?
entries.・・・せっかく取ってきたんだから\nその万能魚のエサは あなたにあげるわ\n\n:
...Since I went to the trouble of getting it,
I'll give you that all-purpose fish bait.

...I don't really know either, but...

If you use that bait in a place with water,
the all-purpose fish will appear.
That's what they say...
entries.なんだ・・・おれっちに 何かようか?\n\n・・・・・・?・・・ハリガネ?\n・:
What... do you have something for me?

...?... A steel wire?
...And a sturdy steel wire that I can't use?

...Hahahaha...
I don't think I have something like that...

...There is, though...

But this is something I worked hard to...
Even so, I picked it up here just now...

...Wow!
Fine! I'll give it to you!...

So please don't look at me like that...
entries.魔ブタ・・・黄金・・・!!\nいくいくっ!・・・・・・\n\nでも、魔ブタはこわ:
Demon pig... gold...!!
I'm going! ...

But the demon pig is scary...
But I'm going!!
entries.わぁっはっは!\nいやぁ!ひさしぶりだなぁ!\n\nえぇ〜っと・・・\n・・・・:
Waaah! Hahaha!
Wow! It's been so long!

Um...
...Who was it again?

Huh? ...You've never met me before? ...
Oh, I see, I see...

So? What's going on? ...
...My precious thing? ...

Gahahaha!
Then it's all good!

After all, I've entrusted it to my most trusted
subordinate.

Waaahahaha!
Wow! It's been so long!

Um...
...Who was it again?

Huh? ...My precious thing?

...Ah, yes, that's right.
I got it back.
...Shall I show you?

...Um...
...Nnn~...

...Dwahahaha! ...
...I lost it!

To make matters worse, the contents too...
I forgot! ...

...I have a good memory.
What a fool I am...
Oh dear!

...Well, whatever!
It's probably on that road,
so I'll give it to you when I find it! ...

Since I forgot about it...
it probably wasn't anything important anyway.

Take it, thief! ...
...Ah! ...

Am I the thief?
Waaahahaha!
entries.いやぁ・・・長かったなぁ\n\nおれたちが\nここを追い出されてどれくらいかなぁ:
Wow... it's been so long.

How long has it been since we were kicked out of here?

I miss it so much.
entries.あぁ? 人魚だぁ?\n\n・・・そう言えば・・・だれかが\nこのマンションのどっ:
Huh? A mermaid?

...Come to think of it... someone said they saw it somewhere in this apartment building...
entries.ドロボウが\n自分たちの すみかを取られてちゃあ\n話しにならんよなぁ・・・:
If the thieves
have their home taken away,
it won't be a conversation, will it…
entries.やっぱり、じぶんの家が\nいちばんだな・・・\n\nまったく、トンバさまさまだよ:
After all, my own house is the best...

Seriously, it's like a tomba-sama...
entries.ああ、人魚かい?・・・\nえ〜っと たしか・・・\n\n上のほうの部屋に\nいた:
Ah, a mermaid, huh?...
Um... I think...

I think she was in the room upstairs...
entries.よおっ! おまえか?\n\nここに魔法をかけてた魔ブタを\nやっつけたのは・・・:
Whoa! Is that you?

The one who defeated the magic pig that was casting magic here… thank you!
entries.ハリガネ?・・・\nまぁ、むかしは使ってたからな・・・\n\nどっかに 一つぐら:
Harigane?...
Well, I used to use it back then...

There should be at least one somewhere.
entries.フンフフン・・・\nおっと、いけねぇ・・・\n\n思わず はなうた\nうたっちま:
Hmm...
Oh no, I shouldn't have...

I couldn't help but sing.
I ended up singing...
entries.何か 探してるのかい?・・・\n\nそういやあ\n穴掘り名人が何か見つけたとか\:
Are you looking for something?...

Oh yeah,
the master of digging holes found something,
wasn't he...?
entries.・・・やっと きたか・・・\n\nおれたちからの お礼に\nイイモノやるよ・・・:
...Finally, it's here...

As a thank you from us,
I'll give you something good...

Though I won't do it again and again.
entries.大きなカギの絵?: A picture of a big key?
entries.よく当たる赤の占い師のいえ\n 今なら無料\nダイナミックキャンペーン中!:
The well-known red fortune teller's house
    Now free
Dynamic campaign underway!
entries.・・・かんばんの先にはり紙がしてある: There is a sticker on the signboard.
entries.外出中\nすぐもどります:
I'm out.
I'll be back soon.
entries.迷子ネズミのお知らせ\n本物の子ネズミが迷子になっています\n\nみなさんのよう:
Notice Regarding Lost Mouse
A real baby mouse has become lost.

Since they are not originally human beings like you,
they need immediate help.

If you find them,
please contact the Central Center first.

We will come to pick them up.
We ask for your cooperation.
Bacchus Village · Central Center
entries.お知らせ\n皆さんのご協力のおかげで、\n子ネズミは ぶじに見つかりました\n\:
Notice
Thanks to everyone's cooperation,
the baby mice were successfully found.

Thank you very much.
Bacchus Village · Central Center
entries.おねがい\n湖のポンプがこわれているため、\n村のおサケがたりません\:
Please
The pump at the lake is broken,
so the village doesn't have enough salmon.

Could someone go to Bacchus Lake
and fix the pump?

Seaf Mansion isn't scary,
we're waiting for brave challengers.
Bacchus Village / Central Center
entries.ん?・・・おおっ!・・・\nどこかで会ったような気がするけど\n・・・だれだっけ:
Hmm? ...Oh! ...
I feel like we've met somewhere before,
but... who was it?
entries.おや?・・・\nどこかで見たかおだと思ったら、\nお前さんは たしかあの時の・・:
Huh?...
I thought I'd seen you somewhere before,
you were definitely that person from back then...
entries.ん?・・・おおっ!\n大トリの山で会った少年じゃないか\n・・・よくぶじだったな:
Hmm? ...Oh!
Isn't that the boy I met at the mountain of the big bird?
...He was good at it, wasn't he?
entries.おいおい、何いってるんだ、\nキノコの森の怪物を\nたいじしたのはその子だぞ:
Hey, what are you talking about?
That kid was the one who fought the monster in the mushroom forest.
entries.はぁーーーっ\n・・・たいしたもんだ、\nまだちっこいのになぁ・・・:
Haaaahhhh...
...That's quite something,
even though it's still so tiny...
entries.・・・そうだ、キノコの森の怪物もいなくなったことだし\n・・・ついでと言っちゃあ:
...That's right, now that the monster in the mushroom forest is gone,
...I don't mean to say this as an afterthought,
but won't you work hard and be requested?

Actually, there's something called the Death God Fruit in the mushroom forest,
and unfortunately, if you leave this fruit alone,
all the other creatures will perish...
entries.だからあんたに、その死神の実を\n代部つぶしてもらいたいんだ: That's why I want you to crush that Death God Fruit.
entries.・・・そうだ、これをもっていきな!\n死神の実の除草剤だ・・・\nこれがないと死:
...That's right, take this with you!
It's a herbicide for the Death God Fruit...
You can't harvest the Death God Fruit without this.
entries.俺たちのしらべでは代部で\n5個ぐらいだと思うんだが・・・\nがんばって ぜんぶ:
In our research, I think there are about five in the substitute section...
Please do your best and crush them all!
entries.死神の実にはカオみたいな\nもようがついてるから\nまちがえないようにな・・・: The Death God Fruit has a pattern like Kao, so don't mistake it...
entries.もう、あの森も安心だな・・・: I guess that forest is safe now...
entries.これもみんなお前さんのおかげだ・・・\nホラ、これはみんなからの礼がわりだ:
This is all thanks to you...
Here, this is a token of gratitude from everyone.
entries.これが死神の実を\nつぶしてくれた分: This is for crushing the Death God's Fruit.
entries.そしてこれが森の怪物を\nやっつけてくれた分だ: And this is for defeating the forest monster.
entries.これでまた、花も\nたねをつけることができるな・・・: With this, the flowers can also set seeds again...
entries.よぉ!トンバじゃねーか・・・どうした、\nなにかききたいことでもあるのかい?\n:
Hey! It's Tomba... What's up?
Is there something you want to ask?

...Ah, I dropped you,
you mean that big shot...
entries.あのトリは、そのむかし\n空の主ってよばれるほど りっぱで、\nりりしかったんだ: That bird was once so magnificent that it was called the lord of the sky, and it was truly splendid…
entries.今ははヨボヨボの\nおじいさんだけどな・・・: Now I'm a frail old man, but...
entries.それに、あの山に嵐が吹くようになってから、\n山に近づけなくなったみたいなんだ・:
Besides, ever since the storms started blowing on that mountain,
it seems like we can't get close to it anymore...
entries.・・・そうだ!\n大トリのこうぶつを食べさせれば、\n少しは元気になるかもしれな:
...That's it!
If I feed him the big bird,
maybe he'll feel a little better...
entries.バンクの花だよ・・・\nマグマのどうくつにところどころ\nはえてるヤツ・・・\n:
It's a bank flower...
There are some growing in places around the magma...

If there are five of those,
it should be okay...
entries.でも、大トリの巣は\n炎の谷の先だからな・・・\n\nもし会いにいくんだったら、:
But the Great Tiger's nest is
beyond the Valley of Fire...

If you're going to meet him,
be very careful...
entries.大トリのこうぶつは\nバンクの花だぞ・・・\nわすれんなよ!: The big trio's koubutsu is a bank flower... don't forget!
entries.おっおっおっ・・・・・・おおっ!\nなおった!! いやぁ・・・たすかったよ\n\:
Whoa whoa whoa... Whoa!
I'm healed!! Oh man... I'm so glad.

I ate some weird mushrooms in the forest...
I thought I was going to cry forever.
entries.・・・ああ、そうだ! あんた、\nコマブタのちっこいヤツ見たことないかい?\n\:
...Oh, right! Have you ever seen those little Komabuta?
They're called Magobuta, but they're hard to find...

If you get one, please let me have it—I'll give you proper thanks.
entries.おおっ!これこれ!!\n・・・よく見つけたなぁ よし!\n\nじゃあ、やくそくの:
Wow! This is it!!
...You found it well! Alright!

Well then, I'll give you something good as a promise.
...Jaaan!!

It's a rare Kokka claw!!
...Eh? Where is it rare?

Well, well, well, don't be so stiff...
Well then, I'll take this... thank you!
entries.私は人のけいけんの、レベルを\nつたえる占い師の一人です\n\nもともと私たちは:
I am one of the fortune tellers who conveys the level of people's experience.
Originally, we can only talk to those with a high level of experience...
However, since I am still studying, I am offering readings separately.
entries.うーむ・・・\n\n・・・ピンクはあついところ・・\n\n・・・ミドリは 湖先の:
Hmm...

...Pink is a hot place...

...Green is a lakeside villa.

...Red waits for a kiss...
entries.かぁ〜・・・やっぱりここのサケが\nいちばんウマイな・・・: Ah... as expected, the salmon here is the best...
entries.・・・となりのヤツ、さっきから\nミルクばっかりのんでるな・・・\n変わったヤツ: ...The guy next door, he's been drinking nothing but milk since earlier... What a strange guy...
entries.ええっ! そんな所にいたんですか?\nわかりました・・・すぐに ほごします\n\:
Eh! Were you in such a place?
Understood... I will protect you right away.

Ah... if you like, again
please watch Keijiban...
entries.おかげで助かりました: Thanks to you, I was saved.
entries.みぃ〜〜たぁ〜〜なぁ〜〜っ!!\n・・・・・・・・・・・\n\n・・・・・・・・:
Mii~taaa~naaa~tsu!!
・・・・・・・・・・・

・・・・・・・・・・・
・・・・・・・・・

What... don't be so surprised.
・・・No, no, sorry...
There wasn't any trouble...

As you can see, we're
just like mice, aren't we?
Of course, we're humans,

・・・This village has been enchanted with
the magic of the demon pig... The village representative
has been transformed...
entries.まぁ、ふだんは おどろかさんように\nこうやってボウシをかぶっておるがな・・・\:
Well, usually I'm like this,
wearing a bowshi like this...

...That's right!
You're a traveler, aren't you?
Would you do me a favor?
entries.わしはシュミでいろんな物を\n集めとるんじゃが・・・\n\nチーズの実がなかなか:
I collect various things in Shumi...

But I can't seem to gather enough cheese nuts...

If you happen to find some cheese nuts on your travels,
would you mind collecting them for me...?

Of course, if you do collect them,
I'll be sure to thank you properly.

That's right, once you've gathered ten,
bring them to me...

I'm looking forward to seeing them.
entries.どうやら集まった様じゃのぉ・・・\nうむ・・・確かにチーズの実じゃ・・・\n\n:
It seems they've gathered...
Hmm... indeed, it's a real cheese...

It must have been difficult...
Now, take this with you.
entries.おおっ!こんなに集めてくれたのか・・・\nこれは、とくべつなお礼をせんといかんな:
Wow! You've gathered so much...
I really need to thank you properly for this...
It's golden fruit...
entries.う〜ん・・・困った・・・\nこんな体じゃなければ・・・\nオレがポンプをなおすの:
Hmm... I'm in trouble...
If I weren't in this condition...
I'd be fixing the pump myself...
entries.おおっ! サケだ!\nまたサケが出るようになったぞ!\n\nずいぶんと助けてもら:
Oh! Salmon!
Salmon has started appearing again!

I've been helped a lot...
There's not much I can thank you for here,
...Oh, right!

I have plenty of sake, so
Feel free to come whenever you need it.
...But don't drink it if you're pregnant.
entries.・・・え?カギを拾ったって?\n・・・ああ、それか・・・いいよ、\n\n持ってい:
...Huh? You picked up a key?
...Ah, or that... Okay,

Take it with you, because if you have it,
one of the doors of the thief's mansion
should open.
entries.よぉ!ずいぶん たすけてもらったな・・・\n・・・まぁ、オレたちもこんな体じゃな:
Hey! You've helped us out a lot...
...Well, if we weren't in this state,
we'd manage on our own...

...If only we could get rid of the magic pig's magic,
we'd return to our original bodies though...

...Oh right, I left a treasure chest in front of the central center,
so if you'd like,
please take it.

...However, I don't know how to open it though...
entries.森はきけんだから\n出ないほうがいいゼ: The forest is dangerous, so you shouldn't go out.
entries.キノコの森には\nボンスギーっていう怪物が出るんだ:
In the mushroom forest,
there's a monster called Bonsugi.
entries.・・・そんなにジロジロ見るなよ・・・\nオレたちは こう見えても\nふつうの人間:
...Don't stare at us so much...
We may look like this, but we're still ordinary humans...
entries.くそぉ・・・こんな体だと\n・・・よっぱらうのが早いや\n・・・ヒック!・・・:
Damn... with a body like this,
...I get drunk so easily,
...Hic!...
entries.いやぁ〜びっくりした・・・\nあんた、きゅうに空から\n落ちてくるんだもん・・・:
Wow, I was surprised...
You're falling from the sky, you know...
entries.大トリの山から来たの?\nあそこも魔ブタに魔法をかけられて、\nすっかり変わって:
Did you come from the mountain of the great bird?
That place was also enchanted by the demon pig,
and has completely changed…
entries.ここは 中央こうえん、\nあの たてものが中央センターだよ:
This is Central Park,
that building over there is the Central Center.
entries.この村の「お知らせ」かんけいは、\nこの「立て札」にはってあるから、\nたまには: The village's "announcements" are posted on this "notice board," so please check them occasionally.
entries.・・・ん?\n見ないカオだね・・・\nここは、バッカスの村だよ・・・:
...Hmm?
I don't see you...
This is the village of Bacchus...
entries.この村はバッカスの湖から\nポンプでサケを送ってたんだ・・・\nみんなの楽しみだ:
This village used to pump salmon from Lake Bacchus...
It was everyone's favorite thing to do...
entries.近ごろサケが少なくって、\nめったに飲めないんだ・・・:
Lately, there aren't many salmon,
so I can hardly drink it...
entries.あんたを乗せてきた大トリは、\n頂先にある自分の巣の方向へ\nとんでいったよ: The great bird that carried you flew towards its own nest at the very tip.
entries.いやぁ・・・この体って、\nけっこう ふべんなんだよね・・・: Well… this body is quite stubborn, you know…
entries.そう言えば・・・\n中央センターのヤツが\n\nシーフマンションの小部屋のカギを:
Come to think of it...
The guy from the Central Center had

the key to the small room in the Thief Mansion,
didn't he...?
entries.中央こうえんの「けいじばん」は、\nこまめにチェックしといたほうがいいゼ: You should check the "keijiban" of Chuo Park frequently.
entries.ウワサじゃ、シーフマンションの\nどっかに「時の老人」のひとりが\n開じ込められ:
Rumor has it that somewhere in the Seaf Mansion,
one of the "Old Men of Time" is trapped...
entries.湖のポンプをなおしてくれたんだって?\n中央センターには ほうこくしたかい?:
Did you fix the pump at the lake?
Did you report it to the central center?
entries.ここはもう、通ってもいいからさぁ・・・\nボンスギーをやっつけてよ・・・:
You can come through here now, you know...
Just take care of Bonsugi...
entries.あんたのおかげで、\nまたサケが飲める・・・\nありがとうよ:
Thanks to you,
I can drink sake again...
Thank you.
entries.このすがたも、なれれば\n楽しいんだけどね・・・:
This form, too, if I could get used to it,
it would be fun...
entries.大トリの山の炎さえ通えれば、\n大トリの巣へいけるんだよ・・・:
If only the mountain flame of the grand finale could pass through,
I could go to the grand finale's nest...
entries.シーフマンションには、\nへやがいっぱいあるからねぇ・・・\nいろいろ調べれば何:
The Seaf Mansion has so many rooms...
If you look around carefully, you might find something.
entries.そういえば・・・占い師のヤツ、\nかえってきたのかなぁ・・・: Come to think of it... I wonder if the fortune teller has returned...
entries.よぉ、トンバ!\nグルピンってしってるかい?\n・・・なんだ、しらないのか?\n:
Hey, Tomba!
Do you know about Gurupin?
...Oh, you don't?

I heard about it too, but
apparently you can't proceed with Magma's Dokuchu
without it...
entries.もう、あきらめてたんだけど\n・・・あんたなら、\n魔ブタを見つけ出せるかもね・:
I had already given up, but...
If it's you,
you might be able to find the demon pig...
entries.・・・ねぇ、あんたさぁ・・・\nこの村に魔法をかけた魔ブタも\nやっつけてくれな:
...Hey, you...
Could you also defeat the magical pig that cast magic on this village?
entries.オレたちも、もとのすがたに\nもどれるのかなぁ・・・: I wonder if we can return to our original form...
entries.・・・よぉ!トンバ・・・\nいつも元気だな・・・\nあんまりムリするなよ:
...Hey! Tongba...
You're always so energetic...
Don't push yourself too hard.
entries.本当に、魔ブタを たおしちまったんだな\n・・・まったく たいしたヤツだよ:
You really took down that demon pig, huh?
...What a remarkable fellow.
entries.おかげで もとの姿にもどれたよ!\nほんっとーに・・・ありがとうなっ!:
Thanks to you, I was able to return to my original form!
Really... thank you so much!
entries.わぁっ!ひさしぶり!?\nみんな すっごく げんきでしょ?\nこれも、トンバのお:
Wow! It's been so long!
Everyone's doing so well, aren't they?
This is all thanks to Tonba.
entries.占い師のなかまたちには\nもうあったかい?:
To the fortune tellers,
is it already warm?
entries.魔ブタってさぁ・・・\nどんなカオしてるんだい?\n\n・・・やっぱり、\nこわ:
A demon pig...
What kind of face does it have?

...I guess it's a scary face after all...
entries.グルピンは、\nつかいこなせるようになったかい?: Have you gotten good at using Grupin?
entries.どこかに 魔王がすんでるって\nはなしなんだけど・・・ほんとうなら、\n一度あっ: There's a story that a demon king lives somewhere... but if it's true, I'd like to meet him once...
entries.この先バッカスの湖につながっているんだが\n・・・とてもあぶないんだ・・・\n持:
It leads to Lake Bacchus from here, but...
...it's very dangerous...
If you don't have any business there, don't go.
entries.おまえさん・・・トンバとかいったっけ?\n湖のポンプをなおしてくれるんだったら、:
You… did you say Tonba or something?
If you can fix the lake pump,
I'll show you the way.
entries.ごくろうさん・・・中央センターへ、\nほうこくするのもわすれずにな・・・:
Thank you very much... to the Central Center,
don't forget to report it...
entries.・・・おれ、思うんだけどさぁ・・・\nなきダケや わらいダケを食ったら\nげどく:
...I think, you know...
If you only eat poisonous mushrooms and laughable ones,
you'll be cured just by poisonous ones, right?

...If there were other mushrooms...
For example, if you chewed on a strange mushroom and went crazy,
what would cure you?

...Well, there are plenty of weird mushrooms over there...

Even if there were such normal mushrooms,
wouldn't that be strange...
entries.・・・えっ? 最後の魔ブタだって?\nよ〜しっ! わかった!\n・・・まかしとけ:
...Huh? The last demon pig?
Alright! Got it!
...Leave it to me!
entries.よぉ、トンバ! ひさしぶりだな\n・・・どうした??\n・・・アルコールがいるっ:
Hey, Tongba! It's been a while.
...What's up??
...You need alcohol?

Sure thing, it's Tongba's request.
Take as much as you want.
...But kids aren't allowed to drink.
entries.人魚の歌岩\nセーブしますか?\n はい→× いいえ→×:
Mermaid Song Rock
Save?
Yes → × No → ×
entries.よぉ、レースに さんかするんだな?\n\n・・・まずは、きめられた せいげん時間:
Hey, you're joining the race, huh?

...First, it's important to finish within the set time limit...

After that...
This dirt motocross course has a goal at the mermaid's song rock...

Apparently, if you set a course record, the mermaid will give you a medal!
entries.どうだ? もう、じゅんびは いいかい?\n・・・さぁ、時間がないぞ! 急げよっ!:
How's it going? Are you ready?
...Come on, we don't have much time! Let's hurry up!!
entries.はじめまして・・・キミ、なかなか速いわね・・・\nおめでとうっ! 銅メダルよ!!:
Nice to meet you... You're quite fast, aren't you?
Congratulations! Bronze medal!!
entries.・・・それと・・・はじめてキロクをだしたキミに、\nわたしからのプレゼントよ・・: ...and... this is a present from me to you, who first wrote a diary entry...
entries.さぁ、次は 銀メダルめざして\nがんばってね!:
Alright, next up is aiming for the silver medal.
Good luck!
entries.かなり 速くなったわね・・・キミ!\nなかなか みどころが あるわよ・・・\n\:
You've gotten quite fast, haven't you...?
You've got some real potential...

Hey! Congratulations! ...Silver medal!!
entries.次は いよいよ 金メダルよ!: Next up, finally, the gold medal!
entries.おめでとうっ!!・・・ついに やったわね!\n・・・キミ・・・そうとうハマッたで:
Congratulations!! ...Finally, you did it!
...You... must have gotten really hooked, didn't you?
I'm sure the development staff will be amazed!!

......

Oh dear... what am I blabbering about...?
Well, anyway... from today on, you're the champion!!
entries.これからも ベストタイムを出しつづけてね・・・: Please continue to give your best time from now on...
entries.お知らせ\nちかいうちに コースレコードを 発表しますので\nもう しばらくおま:
Notice
We will announce the course record soon, so please wait a little longer.
entries.コースレコード発表!\n1位・・・24秒96\n2位・・・26秒55\n3位・・:
Course record announced!
1st place... 24.96 seconds
2nd place... 26.55 seconds
3rd place... 28.01 seconds
entries.再チャレンジする?\nする→○ しない→×:
Will you try again?
Do → ○ Don't → ×
entries.なにかを取り付ける穴があいている・・・: There's a hole for attaching something...
entries.・・・・・・かすかにポンプのおとがきこえる\n・・・どうやら なおったようだ・・:
...I can faintly hear the sound of a pump.
...It seems to have been fixed...
entries.ふぅ、なんとか たどりついたな\n・・・おれはここで待ってるから、\nよろしくな:
Phew, I somehow made it here.
...I'll be waiting here, so
please take care.
entries.死神の実をひとつ つぶした: I crushed one of the Death God's fruits.
entries.死神の実をふたつ つぶした: I crushed two Death God Fruits.
entries.死神の実を3コ つぶした: I crushed three Death God Fruits.
entries.死神の実を4コ つぶした: I crushed four Death God Fruits.
entries.死神の実をすべて つぶした: I crushed all the Death God's Fruits.
entries.このさき大トリの山・・・\n\nいつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・\nわ:
This mountain ahead...

It's always windy, a very dangerous mountain...
I've been watching this place since I was told by the elder...
...but it's really boring...

So, I always practice here.
Huh? What kind of practice?

...Actually, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practicing is very difficult...
What kind of face will make everyone feel something...?
entries.ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!\nそ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・\n・・・:
Huh?... Whoa!
That, that Kaoshi filled with love! ...
...I see...

The laugh from earlier,
I have mastered the current crying...
Hmm... hmm...

...nnn
I saw it!!
Yeah! Thanks!!

I feel like I can grasp something thanks to you!
Oops, I can't stay like this.
...From now on, it's over!!
entries.おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・\n花のナミダ、めぐみさまのふっかつにかかせない:
I came to take the flower's tears...
The flower's tears, I can't let Megumi-sama's fukkatsu go.

...If I could make this bud bloom,
it seems like tears will flow... but
...I don't know how to collect the tears.
entries.やっぱり、ウワサにきく\nナミダのびん ひつようかも\n・・・こまった・・・:
As expected, I hear rumors.
I might need a bottle of tears...
...This is troublesome...
entries.はじまりの村に出かけますので、\nしばらく ふねは出せません: I'm going to the village of beginnings, so I won't be able to ship for a while.
entries.やぁ、またあったね・・・\nふねに のりたいのかい?\n\nそれはかまわないけど:
Hey, we met again...
Do you want to ride on the boat?

That's fine, but
I'm busy too, so
just Kata Michi.
entries.ナミダのビンちょうだい: Give me a bottle of tears.
entries.浜辺の近草をつかった: I used the grass near the beach.
entries.ジャングル\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→× いいえ→×:
Jungle

Do you want to save?
Yes → × No → ×
entries.老木の丘\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→× いいえ→×:
Old Tree Hill

Save?
Yes → × No → ×
entries.からくり村\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→× いいえ→×:
Karakuri Village

Do you want to save?
Yes → × No → ×
entries.・・・いって〜〜〜\n\n・・・コラコラ、少年!\n・・・らんぼうなヤツだなぁ・:
...Hey there~~~

...Hey there, boy!
...What a naughty brat...

...Suddenly biting like that...
...Hmm? ...Wait a minute...
entries.・・・うん、わかった・・・\n頼んでみるよ・・・:
...Okay, I understand...
I'll give it a try...
entries.・・じぃさんは、気にするなってさ・・・ちぇ\n・・・それと・・ひとつ頼みがあるん:
...Jii-san says not to worry about it... Che.
...And... I have one request...

As you can see, Jii-san is already old...
He can no longer absorb nutrients on his own,
and his energy is steadily fading...

There seems to be only one way to revive this old tree... That is...
entries.この大陸のあちらこちらに\nポンプ岩ってのがあるんだけど・・・\n\n実は、その:
There are things called pump rocks scattered all over this continent...

Actually, they contain plenty of nutrient-rich water...

Probably, if you step on all the pump rocks and return the nutrients to the ground,
old trees should regain their vitality...
entries.よぉ、少年!\n全てのポンプ岩をふんでくれたんだな\n・・・大変だったろ?\n\:
Hey, boy!
You stepped on all the pump rocks, didn't you?
...That must have been tough, huh?

...Thanks to that, even old man Jii-san
has completely recovered his energy...
entries.じぃさんからの伝言だよ・・・\nこの老木は 百識の老木と言われるぐらい\nいろん:
It's a message from Grandpa...
This old tree is said to be a hundred-knowledge tree,
it knows so much...

So, if you have anything you want to ask this Grandpa in the future,
come back again...
entries.おおうっ!!・・・おまえっ!\nオレたちのなかまっ!\n・・・ひとりもキズつけな:
Whoa!! ...You!
Our comrades!
...Not a single one was harmed!
entries.おまえ えらいっ!\n・・・えらいなっ!\n・・・えらいぞっ!\n\nフンガのタ:
You're amazing!
...You're amazing!
...You're amazing!

If I had Hunga's taiko drum,
I'd feel like dancing!!
...Oh,

...This is a secret
...Forget it!!
entries.おまえっ!\n・・・??人の なかまっ!\n・・・キズつけたっ!!\n\nとても:
You!
...?? Someone's friend!
...You scratched it!!

I absolutely can't forgive you!
...But~!
I'll give you a little chance!

From now on!
You!

Your past actions!
I'll make you regret it!

If you've been doing good things!
That much I'll forgive!!

For scratching my friend!
I'll forgive you specially!!

...Hungaaaah!
...Hongaaaah!
...Hai! Hai! Hai!!
entries.おおうっ!!\n・・・おまえっ!\n\n・・・けっこうイイヤツ!\nとくべつに:
Ohhh!!
...You!

...Quite a good guy!
I'll forgive you especially!
entries.なんだ・・・おまえ、\nおよげないのか?\n困ったヤツだなぁ・・・:
What... you can't swim?
What a troublesome guy...
entries.まぁ・・・オイラが\n泳ぎをおしえてやってもいいんだけど・・・\n\nおっと、バ:
Well... I could teach you how to swim, but...

Oh, never mind the banana—it's fine now...
I love it, but I've already eaten a bit of it...

Anyway, my throat feels dry...
entries.あ、そうだ・・・オイラさぁ\n文明の国の入口ちかくで\nボウシをひろったんだ・・:
Oh, right... I...
I picked up a hat near the entrance of a civilized country...

If you're going to a civilized country,
would you give it to its owner?

I think they're probably in trouble...
entries.・・・いや、だから・・・バナナは\nもういいんだってば・・・おまえ、\n人のはな:
...No, that's why... bananas are
enough already, I said... you,
you're not listening to anyone's story...
entries.おおっ!\nそれはまさしく バナナジュース!!\n\nいつも わるいな・・・あと:
Wow!
That's exactly banana juice!!

It's always bad... I'll enjoy it slowly later...
entries.それじゃ、やくそくどおり\nオイラが泳ぎをおしえてやるよ\n\nじゅんびは いい:
Well then, as promised,
I'll teach you how to swim.

Are you ready?
If you'd like, anytime
Jump into that river.
entries.おぉ〜い! 聞こえるかぁ〜!\n・・・まずは おちつけ!\nあばれるから しずん:
Hey! Can you hear me?!
...First, calm down!
If you get excited, you'll end up making a mess!
entries.・・・そうそう・・・\nふつうにしてれば 水に浮くことができるんだ\n・・・でも:
...That's right...
If you do it normally, you can float on the water.
...But don't relax!
entries.そして! あわてず さわがず\n進みたい方向に 方向キーをいれながら\n×ボタン:
And! Don't panic, don't panic.
While pressing the direction key in the direction you want to go,
press the × button!

Every time you press the × button,
you can move forward!

It's the × button!

...
...Hmm~
...Isn't it quite good...?

...By the way, the left side of this river is a waterfall, so if you fall,
you won't survive!
entries.そして! あわてず さわがず\n進みたい方向に 方向キーをいれながら\n○ボタン:
And! Don't panic, don't panic.
While pressing the direction key in the direction you want to go,
press the ○ button!

Every time you press the ○ button,
you can move forward!

It's the ○ button!

...
...Hmm~
...Isn't it quite good...?

...By the way, the left side of this river is a waterfall, so if you fall in,
you won't survive!
entries.そうそう! その調子!\n・・・よ〜し、いいぞ・・・:
Yes, yes! That's the spirit!
...Alright, good job...
entries.・・・もう、だいじょうぶみたいだな・・・\nじゃあ、こっちのハシゴに飛びつくんだ:
...It looks like everything's going to be okay now...
Then, jump onto this ladder!

When jumping, press the up key while jumping in front of the ladder!!
entries.・・・よ〜しっ!\n\n・・・いやぁ・・・こんなに早く\n泳ぎをマスターできるな:
...Alright!

...Wow... to be able to master swimming so quickly...
...I'm surprised too...
entries.やぁ!\nさっきは たいへんだったな・・・\nめげずに がんばるかい?\n\nヤ:
Hey!
That was tough earlier...
Are you going to keep going without giving up?

If you've got the will,
jump into the river...
I'll keep playing along with you as many times as you want!
entries.・・・ん? なんだい・・・\n聞きたいことがあるのかい?\n\n・・・ふむふむ・:
...Hmm? What is it...?
Do you have something you want to ask?

...Hmm hmm... the five golden items?
...Got it, just wait a moment.
entries.・・・何か すごくムズカシイものを\n集めようとしてるなぁ・・・\n\nいいかい:
...I'm trying to gather something really difficult...

Listen...
According to Old Man Jii...
entries.・・・金の花は、ドワーフの花だん・・・\n・・・黄金のフルーツは、バッカスの村・:
...The golden flower is in the dwarf's flower garden...
...The golden fruit is in Bacchus' village...
...The golden swallowtail butterfly is in the hidden village...

...The golden drop is in the Demon King's hut...
...There's just one more thing left...
...I forgot what it was...

But they say the motocross course area is suspicious.
Also...like with all items...
you have to do something at that location to get it...
entries.やぁ!元気かい?\n・・・なんか自信なくしちゃうなぁ:
Hey! How are you?
...I feel like I'm losing confidence somehow.
entries.ああ、とうさんのべんとう!\nとってもおいしいんだよ\n\n・・・わざわざ とど:
Ah, Dad's bento!
It's really delicious!

...He went out of his way to deliver it for me.
But I'm already full, so I'll give that bento to you.

...Just eat it as if you were being tricked—it'll give you energy!
Even if you're genuinely fooled, don't get mad...
I'll give you this too.

Well, I'm off!
entries.ああ、とうさんの 元気がでるべんとうを 食べたんだね\n気にすることはないさ・・:
Ah, you ate your father's bento box, which gave him energy, didn't you?
There's no need to worry about that... so, how was the fish?

I see, it was delicious!!
Hearing that made me feel energized too.

...Well then, I'm off now.
...See you later.
entries.うわあぁぁぁーーーっ!\nこっ こないでっ! おねがいっ!\n・・・・・・・・・:
Uwaaaaaaaahhh!
Don't come! Please!
... ... ... ... Huh? ...

Wh-what is it... isn't it the Masakari tribe...?
Ah~ I was startled...
Sorry for scaring you...

I came from the clock tower in the civilized country ahead...
entries.この辺でボウシを\n風に飛ばされちゃってさぁ・・・\n\nさっき ヘンテコリンな:
Around here, my hat got blown away by the wind...

Just now, I saw a strange monkey holding it,
but...

Even if I wanted to chase after it myself...
I'm scared of the Masakari tribe, so I can't go... you know...

If you happen to see a weird monkey wearing striped pants,
could you somehow get it back for me...?
entries.うおぉぉぉーーーっ!!・・・・・・\nだから、急に声をかけるなって・・・\n\n:
Wooo
So, don't suddenly call out to me...

I'm just a small person...

So, did you find my hat?
entries.これだよ、これっ!\n・・・ありがとう おかげで助かったよ・・・\n\nもし、よ:
This is it!
...Thank you, that really helped...

If you'd like, would you like to visit our clock tower?

...The processing facility and the iron castle are probably off-limits, but...
You can always come to the clock tower anytime...
entries.なんじゃ!\n・・・かってに 人の家にあがりこんでくるとは\n失礼なヤツじゃな・:
What!
...To come into someone's house without permission,
what a rude fellow...

Hmm?...A perennial old man?
...This is it!!
To abandon someone, what a thing!!
entries.・・・・・・・・・何じゃ?\n魔ブタの話が聞きたいじゃと?\n\n・・・・・・そ:
...What is it?
You want to hear the story of the demon pig?

...I see...
What 100 years and 1000 years were saying was
about you...

Hmm...
Then, let's do this...

This mechanical village
is submerged in water as you can see...

Within that water, there are 10 balls
with numbers written on them...

If you can collect them all...
I will save what you want to hear...
entries.・・・ただし!\n・・・泳げるだけでは 数字玉は集められんぞ・・・\n潜ることが:
...However!
...Just being able to swim won't let you collect the numbered balls...
If you can't dive, that is...

Hyaa! Hyaa! Hyaa!...

Oh dear... don't glare at me with such a scary face...
Well then, let me tell you something good.
entries.・・・少し前に\nわしのところに人魚がたずねてきてな・・・\n\n何でも 探して:
...A little while ago,
a mermaid came to visit me...

Apparently, she found something important she was looking for
in the middle of the waterfall ahead,
but she said she couldn't get it herself...
