must submit to the strong...

...Hmm? ...This is...?
entries.そうか! 友達か!・・・・・・\n友達を7人 つれてくるんじゃな・・・:
I see! A friend, huh! ...
You're bringing seven friends with you, aren't you...?
entries.・・・・・・フムフム・・・・・・これは、\nいっしゅのカラクリのようじゃな・・・:
...Hmm... This seems like a single mechanism...

The demon pig that was on this pedestal has disappeared, so the door has opened...

If that's the case... someone should just stand on these seven pedestals again...

Then, the door should open again...
entries.よしっ!・・・わしは あなたが\nもどってくるまで ここで待っているから\n\n:
Alright! ...I'll be waiting here until you come back.
...Please tell your friend to come straight here, and I'll handle the rest of the explanation.
...I'm counting on you...
entries.おおっ! そうじゃ・・・思い出したっ!\n・・・あなたに こいつを\nあずけてお:
Oh! That's right... I remembered!
...I'll leave this to you...
entries.どうですかな?\n・・・・・・おぼえておりますかな\n\n・・・こいつは あなた:
How about it?
...Do you remember?

...This is the little bird you helped in the Dwarf Forest.

...I was taking care of it because it finally got better.

Baron has an unbelievable power.
When you use Baron on the item screen,
there's a similar feather to Megumi's feather.

...Well, Baron... go ahead and say it...
entries.おおっ!\nそうじゃ・・・思い出したっ!\n\n・・・あなたに こいつを\nあず:
Oh!
That's right... I remembered!

...I'll leave this to you...
entries.こいつは バロンと言いましてな\n\n・・・・・・ドワーフの森で\nケガをしてい:
This guy is called Baron.

...In the Dwarf Forest,
I was raising him because he was injured...

He'll surely be helpful...
Please treat him like a friend and take good care of him...
Baron has an unbelievable power...

...When you use Baron in the item screen,
there's a similar feather to the Blessing Feather...
...Well then, Baron... go ahead...
entries.・・・ん〜っ・・・\nなにか つくりたいなぁ・・・\n\nおれの ウデをふるえる:
...Hmm...
I want to create something...

Is there anything that would make me feel like I'm putting my skills to work?
Something that gives me a sense of accomplishment...
entries.・・・えぇっ!\nあんた マサカリ族につかまったのか?\n・・・よく、無事だった:
...Eh!
Did you get caught by the Masakari tribe?
...Well, you were safe...
entries.そういえば・・・\n\nウワサに聞いたんだけど マサカリ族は\nむかしから フン:
Come to think of it...

I heard a rumor that the Masakari tribe
has been holding festivals using Hunga's large Taiko drums
since ancient times...

They say it makes a wonderful sound, but
the village fees are quite difficult to obtain...
If only I could get the village fees... I'd like to make one!

...That's right!
...If it's the tree of knowledge,
it might know something...
entries.キミ、いろんなところを旅してるんだって?\nだったら、へんな点とか線がきざんであ:
I hear you've been traveling around various places?
If so, there are some strange dots and lines on the rock... haven't you seen it before?

I saw it a long time ago at a woodcarver's workshop,
but I've been curious about it ever since...
entries.ウワサじゃ\n代部で6つのらくがき岩があって、\n\nそこに書かれてあるナゾをと:
It's just a rumor,
but there are six scribbled rocks in the Daibu area,
and if you solve the riddles written on them,
you can apparently obtain many treasures.
...It seems difficult though...
...but 1... but 5...

Something about base 20 and something else...
I really don't understand it...
entries.キミ、この先の時計台に 何か用かい?: Do you have something to do at the clock tower ahead?
entries.ざんねんだけど・・・\n今、時計台はこわれてて\n動かないんだ・・・:
It's a shame...
Right now, the clock tower is broken
and doesn't work...
entries.・・・そうだ!\nこの少年におねがいして、\n鉄人にたのんでもらおうか?:
...That's it!
Let's ask this boy to ask the Iron Man to do it?
entries.でも・・・鉄人にたのむのは\nシャクだしなぁ・・・: But... asking Iron Man would be rude, wouldn't it?
entries.どうだった?\nおれの作ったジュースはウマかっただろ?\n・・・・・・何だって!:
How was it?
The juice I made was delicious, wasn't it?
...What!?

...You swam across that river?...
That's amazing...

That river is famous for its fast current.
...That's right!...

I have a request for you, considering your courage.
Actually... as you can see...
entries.・・・この時計台はずっと\n止まったままなんだ・・・\n\nここのハグルマを動か:
...This clock tower has been
stopped forever...

To move this Haguruma,
you need to operate the machinery...
But there are various obstacles...

Well, please take a look at the machine room in the Iron Castle once...

I'll make sure the processing plant and Iron Castle are
freely accessible...
entries.ほんとうに キカイを動かしちまうなんてな\n・・・おかげで、時計台が生き返ったよ:
Really, moving the machines like that...
...Thanks to that, the clock tower came back to life...

Hmm? Oh, in Haguruma's room,
you shouldn't go anymore... because a lot of big Haguruma are moving around.

It's very dangerous...
entries.よぉ! あの時のボウズじゃないか・・・\n\nどうだい? この時計台・・・\nな:
Hey! Isn't that the same old fool from back then...?

How about this clock tower...?
It's quite impressive, isn't it?

When you combine this clock tower, the iron castle, and the processing plant,
they call it a civilized country.

...Well, even if you call it civilization, all the machines are
completely stopped though...

...Oh, by the way...
Thanks to you, I didn't lose my precious hat.

...Really, thank you...

...I want to do something to show my gratitude...
...That's right!

Please drink some of my Jiman juice.
...It's delicious~
entries.・・・とっとっと・・・ しまった!\nかんじんのバナナがねーや・・・\n\nなに:
...Totto... Oh no!
I don't have any bananas...

You see, my specialty is banana juice.

...But you know... bananas are in the jungle...
The jungle is with machetes...
entries.おお ボウズっ!\n時計台の歯車・・・\nおまえが直してくれたんだってな・・・\:
Oh no, a dud!
The clock tower's gears...
I heard you fixed them for me...

Still, iron gears, huh...
Looks like I got a new Iron Man on my hands
It's a bit awkward though...

Well, with that one,
it shouldn't break, right? Uh-huh.

...Ah, right!
I'll treat you to some juice
That was annoying...

...And, oh no...
I don't have any bananas at all

...What's my specialty?
Banana juice...
But you know...

Bananas grow in the jungle...
And the jungle is full of machetes...
entries.おおっ!?・・・\nなんだ、わざわざ取ってきてくれたのか?\n・・・よ〜し・・・:
Oh!?...
Oh, you went out of your way to get it for me?
...Alright then... just wait a moment.
entries.・・・はあっ!!・・・\nフン! フン! フン!\n\n・・・ぎゅ〜っ とな・・:
...Hah! ...
Hmph! Hmph! Hmph!

...gulp~...
Gyu gyu gyu~n...
entries.おれの作るジュースは人気あるんだぜ\n味わって のんでくれよ\n・・・ああ、それ:
The juice I make is popular, you know.
Please taste and drink it.
...Oh, and...

It's better not to get close to the river...
That said... no one would swim in such a fast-flowing place...

Well, if there was someone brave enough to swim there...

Maybe they could defeat our troubles too...
entries.なぁなぁ、聞いてくれよ・・・\nおれさぁ 始まりの村から\n 帰ってきたんだけど:
Hey hey, listen to this...
I came back from the village of beginnings...

And there, for the first time...
I saw the Demon King!

They say his name is Mizuno...
But he's so cute...

Ah~...
I wish I could meet him again...
entries.この、カベにくっついてる\nエレベーターらしいんだけど・・・\n動かないんだよね:
This thing is stuck to the wall.
It seems to be an elevator, but...
It doesn't work at all...
entries.何だって・・・ほかの町に入れない?\n・・・知らねぇーな・・・\nあんなヤツラと:
What... can't I enter another town?
...I don't know...
I don't want to get involved with those guys...
entries.ほかの町のヤツラ・・・\n\nどうも わたしたちのこと\nバカにしてるみたい・・:
The people from other towns...

It seems like they're looking down on us...
I'm getting so angry!
entries.この町は はじめてかい?\n\nそうだなぁ\nじまんできるのは時計台ぐらいなんだ:
Is this town your first time?

Well...
The only thing I can boast about is the clock tower, but...
it's a little...
entries.はいろぉーかなぁ・・・\n\nでも井戸には入るなって\nいわれてるしなぁ・・・\:
I wonder if I should go...

But I've been told not to go near the well...
What should I do...?
entries.なんだ・・・\nハグルマ 見てきたのか?\n\n・・・う〜ん・・・\nどうしたも:
What...
Did you see Haguruma?

...Hmm...
What should I do...
entries.こわれないハグルマ?\nそりゃあ、鉄で作れば・・・\n\nでも、あたしは\n木と:
A haguruma that won't break?
Well, if you make it out of iron...

But I don't want wood or iron...
entries.へへ・・・こっそり、\n鉄人の町と木人の町のトビラ・・・\n\nあけてきちゃった:
Hehe... secretly,
the door between the town of the iron man and the town of the wooden man...

I opened it...
It's a secret...
entries.ハツデンキ? ・・・ああ、それだ!\nこの小屋についてるエレベーターも\nそいつ:
Hatsudenki? ... Oh, that's it!
The elevator attached to this hut was also
operated by that thing.
entries.あんた、まだ ちいさいのに\nがんばるねぇ・・・\n\nあたしも\nへんないじを:
You're still so little,
but you're working hard...

I also
should stop playing weird games...
entries.おれさぁ、\nむかし 川に入ろうとしたら・・・\n\nいきなり\nビリビリッてき:
You know,
once when I tried to go into the river...

it suddenly gave me a shocking electric shock.
I wonder what it was...
entries.へへ・・・\nイタズラしたのバレちゃった・・・\n\nでも、みんながケンカしてる:
Hehe...
They found out I was playing pranks...

But when everyone's fighting,
it's just boring.
entries.ハツデンキは動いたが・・・\nこの国を囲むカベの中ではキカイは動かない・・・\n:
Hatsudenki moved, but...
Within the walls surrounding this country, machines don't move...
Is it really a demon pig after all...?
entries.みんなと\nなかなおり したいんだけどねぇ・・・\n\nまだ\nみんなギクシャク:
I really want to reconcile with everyone, but...

Everyone's still feeling awkward...
entries.ふるいけから、\nからくり村へ 行くのかい?\n・・・がんばれよ!:
From the old well,
are you going to Karakuri Village?
...Good luck!
entries.おにーちゃんなら\nこの国に魔法をかけた魔ブタも\nやっつけてくれるよね・・・:
If it's big brother,
he'll defeat the magical pig that cast magic on this country, right...?
entries.動かない時計台: A clock tower that doesn't move.
entries.鉄人の町\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→× いいえ→×:
Town of the Iron Man

Do you want to save?
Yes → × No → ×
entries.なぁ・・・おめぇ、しってるかい?\n\nジャングルの横を流れる川を\n流れに逆ら:
Hey... do you know?

There's a river flowing next to the jungle,
and if you go upstream against the current,
there's a waterfall, right?
entries.ああ・・・ときどき、\n丸太が落っこちてくる\nあの滝だろ・・・:
Ah... sometimes,
a log falls down.
That waterfall, right?
entries.そうそう・・・なんでも、あの滝の上には\n大きな水たまりが あるらしいぜ: Yeah, yeah... I heard there's a big puddle on top of that waterfall.
entries.へぇーっ・・・\n一度見てみたいもんだなぁ\n\n・・・でも、こっちからは\nい:
Wow...
I'd really like to see that once.

...But from my side,
it's not something I can do.
entries.ああ、たぶんな・・・でも、\n始まりの村の ふるいけから\n行けるとか 聞いたこ:
Ah, probably... but,
I've heard you can go from the old well in the starting village...
entries.ん? なんだい\nおいらに何か用かい?\n\nおいら、こう見えても\nりっぱな鉄:
Hmm? What's up?
Do you need something from me?

I may look like this,
but I'm a respectable ironworker...

If you want me to make something out of iron,
come anytime...
entries.ん? なんだって?\n鉄のハグルマを作れるかって?\n\nはっはっはっ・・・\n:
Huh? What did you say?
Can you make an iron haguruma?

Hahahaha...
I shouldn't make you laugh.

If it's in my hands,
it will be done in no time…

I want to say that, but…
Unfortunately, I'm running low on iron village fees right now.

…If you bring me some village fees,
I'll make it for you right away.
entries.ん! これは いい村料だな\n・・・ちょっと まってな・・・:
Hmm! This is a good village fee.
...Wait a minute...
entries.ほらよ! おいらの手にかかれば\nこんなもんよ! さぁ、持っていきな:
Here you go! If you put it in my hands,
it'll be like this! Now, take it.
entries.しかし、鉄のハグルマなんて\n何につかうんだい?: But what would you use an iron haguruma for?
entries.おめぇさん・・・\n石の時計台を直したんだってな\n\n・・・まぁ、ものを直すっ:
You...
I heard you fixed the stone clock tower.

...Well, fixing things is a good thing... thank you.
entries.どうだった? 歯車は動いたかい?\n・・・・・・そうだろうな・・・\n\nおれは:
How was it? Did the gears move?
...I guess so...

I was told by Gantetsu Hakudo
to come after you...

Apparently, just fixing the gears isn't enough
to make the clock tower work...

To operate the machinery, you need electricity
...Well, for the details, ask Gantetsu Hakudo
...
entries.まさか ほんとうに\nキカイを動かしちまうなんてな\n\n・・・まったく たいし:
No way, really?
To actually set the machine in motion...

...What a remarkable fellow.
...Hmm?

Ah, you shouldn't go to the gear room anymore...

There are so many large gears moving around,
it's incredibly dangerous...
entries.・・・これが ハツデンキ・・・\nでも、どうやって 動かすんだろう?:
...This is a heart-shaped electric...
But how do you make it work?
entries.フムフム・・・まずは\nねんりょうだな・・・:
Hmm... first of all,
it's energy...
entries.・・・でも、そんなもの\nどこにあるんだよ: ...but where would something like that be?
entries.フーム・・・そうだな・・・\n石炭でもあれば・・・:
Hmm... that's right...
If only we had some coal...
entries.石炭か・・・ん?\nまてよ・・・そういえば\n木人の町のどこかに あったような・:
Coal... hmm?
Wait a minute... come to think of it,
I think there was something like that somewhere in the town of Kijin...
entries.ほいさっ! ほいさっ!: Here you go! Here you go!
entries.・・・どうやら\n熱ぼうそう みたいだな・・・: ...It seems like it's a feverish rash...
entries.ああ、キカイが熱で動かなくなったのさ\n・・・しかし、こまったな・・・:
Ah, the machine stopped working because of the heat...
...But now I'm in trouble...
entries.そうかっ!\nじゃあ、おれの出番だな\n・・・ちょっとまってろよっ!:
I see!
Well, it's my turn now.
...Wait a minute!
entries.これだこれだ・・・こいつを\nここんところに 取り付けて: This is it... install this here.
entries.さぁーて・・・これで大丈夫だろ\n・・・そくせきの空冷ファンだ!:
Well then... this should be fine, right?
...That's the air-cooled fan!
entries.それじゃあ もう一回やるぞ! それっ!: Alright then, let's do it again! Here we go!
entries.・・・いやぁ あんたには\nほんとうに せわになったなぁ・・・\n\n・・・そう:
...Well, you've really been busy, haven't you?
...Speaking of which...I heard that you're traveling around with a demon pig?
entries.ほら・・・\nこのジャングルに魔法をかけたヤツの\n封印ぶくろだ\n\n・・・役:
Here...
It's the seal bag from the guy who cast magic on this jungle.

...I don't know if it'll be useful, but
if you like it, take it...
entries.しかし・・・こんな少年が\n魔ブタと 戦ってるなんて\nすごいよな・・・: But... it's amazing that a boy like this is fighting against a demon pig...
entries.魔ブタのことなら 滝の上にある\n大きな水たまりにいる 万年老人って人が\nくわ:
If it's about the Demon Pig, there's a man called the Eternal Old Man who lives in a large puddle above the waterfall, and he seems to know a lot about it...
Well, anyway, you should meet him once.
However... you can't go to the top of the waterfall unless you come from the old gate of the Beginning Forest...
It's a bit of a detour, but be careful on your way...
entries.万年老人!\n・・・あの イジワルじぃさんか?:
A perpetual old man!
...Is that the mean old man?
entries.おい おい・・・かりにも、\n時の老人のひとりだぞ・・・\n\nそんなことはない:
Hey, hey... even if it's just a little,
you're one of the old men of time...

That probably won't happen...
Well, anyway, just meet him once.
entries.ふるいけをぬけるトビラには \nカギがかかっているからな・・・\n\nほら、これ:
The door leading to the sieve is locked...

Here, take this—it's the key for the sieve...
entries.老木の丘からイカダにでも のれば\nシーフマンションまで戻れるはずだ・・・\n\:
If you could get on a raft from the hill of old trees,
you should be able to return to Seaf Mansion...

I'll leave it at the processing plant,
so please take it.
entries.・・・力を合わせれば・・・\n何とかなるもんだな・・・:
...If we work together...
We can make it work somehow...
entries.・・・きっと あのカベのせいじゃないかな・・・\nむかしは おれたち もっとなか:
...I guess it's probably because of that wall...
Back then, we were much closer friends...
entries.・・・・・・う〜〜〜ん・・・・・\n\n鉄の城も こうなっちまうと \nどうしよ:
...Hmm...

Even an iron castle, once it's like this,
there's nothing you can do about it...

...Hmm...

Even an iron castle, once it ends up like this,
There's nothing I can do about it...

...Hmm... hmm?
...What? Were you listening...?

...Indeed, beyond this door lies
It's a machine room, but... look, as you can see.
...This is absolutely impossible to open...

...I've been neglecting it for a long time, haven't I?
...and finally, I stopped at the Hatsudenki inside.
This is how it is...

Seriously, there's no name for a civilized country...
entries.・・・こんなに さびついてたらなぁ・・・\n押しても 引いてもビクともしねぇや:
...I wish it wasn't so rusty...
No matter how much I push or pull, it won't budge at all.
entries.ガンテツ?\n・・・ああ、あのへんくつの\nガンテツ博土かい?\n\n博土なら:
Gantetsu?
...Ah, that awkward
Gantetsu Hakudo?

If it's Hakudo, I went back to my own cabin.
...Look, that
Cabin in the middle you can reach from the lift.
entries.・・・地下迷路の魔ブタゲートか・・・\nほかならぬトンバのたのみだ\n・・・やっ:
...Is it the Demon Pig Gate in the underground labyrinth...?
It's none other than Tonba's request.
...I'll do it!
entries.・・・ふん! 見なれないカオだな・・・\nこの先には 鉄の城があるんだが・・・\:
...Hmph! What an unfamiliar face...
Beyond this point lies an iron castle...
If you have no business here, then leave...

Hmm?
Me? My name is Gantetsu...

Well, if you're useful to this country,
I'll lend you a hand...
entries.・・・まさか、お前さんみたいな少年が\n時計台を直してしまうとはな・・・\nいや:
...I never thought a boy like you would fix the clock tower...
No, I'm sorry for being rude until now...
And...
entries.お前さんが せっかく直してくれた\n時計台だが・・・\n\nあれを本当に動かすに:
The clock tower you painstakingly fixed...

To really get it running,
you have to operate the power switch in the iron castle ahead...

But... there's one problem...

Well, first things first—go to the iron castle
and verify it with your own eyes...
entries.よぉ・・・開かないトビラは 見てきたかい?\n・・・あれは 古いトビラでな・・・:
Hey... have you seen the door that won't open?
...That's an old door...

You'd have to use a bomb to blow it away,
otherwise you wouldn't be able to get inside at all...
entries.バクダンの作り方?\n・・・はあっ!はあっ!はっ!\n・・・おいおい、本気にした:
How to make a Bakudan?
...Hah! Hah! Hah!
...Hey, did you really take this seriously?

You're such an honest guy...
Well, to be fair, no one's ever gone that far before...

...Alright! Let's give it a shot!
In exchange... I have a few things I'd like you to gather for me...
entries.バクダンを作るためには まず、\nこの小屋の そうちを動かすために\n少しの電気:
To make a Bakudan, first,
it seems like a little electricity is needed
to move the furnace in this hut...

This would be enough if there were an electric eel in the jungle...

And, the black water that will become the basis of the Bakudan...
once those two are ready,
bring them here... I'm counting on you!
entries.ちょっとまった!\n電気ウナギを素手でつかまえる気か?\n\n・・・まったく あ:
Wait a minute!
Are you trying to catch an electric eel with your bare hands?

...What a scatterbrain you are...
Here, take this with you...
entries.ん!\n二つとも そろったようだな・・・\nでは、村料は あずかろう・・・:
Hmm!
It seems both have arrived...
Then, the village fee will be Azura...
entries.・・・よぉしっ! これでバクダンの素を\n作ることができるぞ!\n・・・そうだ!:
...Alright! With this, I can make the ingredients for a bomb!
...That's right!

It's a bit of a bother to ask, but...
while I'm making the ingredients for the bomb,
could you go get some coconuts?

I think they were attached to one of the trees in the jungle...

If you stuff the bomb ingredients into the coconut shell,
it will be completed happily!
entries.おおっ!\nやっときたか・・・じゃあ、\nヤシの実をあずかろうか・・・:
Oh!
Finally, you've arrived... then,
shall I take a coconut?
entries.このバクダンの素を\nヤシのカラにつめてと\n・・・よし、完成だ!!:
I stuffed the base of this Bakudan into the palm of my hand...
...Alright, it's finished!!
entries.ん?\n何だ まだバクダンがほしいのか?\n\nヤシの実さえあれば\nいくつでも:
Hmm?
What? You still want a bomb?

As long as you have coconuts,
I'll make as many as you want...
entries.うーん・・・やっぱりダメか\n・・・キミってスゴイな・・・:
Hmm... I guess it's no good after all.
...You're amazing...
entries.上に行きたいのかい?・・・\nだったら この小屋に入りなよ:
Do you want to go up?...
Then go into this hut.
entries.よくきたね・・・\nここは鉄人の町って言うんだ・・・:
You came here, huh...
This is called the Iron Man Town, you know...
entries.丈夫で ながもち・・・\nやっぱ 鉄って いいよなぁー:
Durable and long-lasting...
I guess iron really is great, huh?
entries.あたい 思うんだけどさぁ・・・\nどうして みんな いがみあうんだろ?・・・\n:
I think...
Why do people always end up hating each other?...
It's just so unpleasant...
entries.どいつもこいつも\n木だの石だの\nやわなこと 言いやがって・・・\n\n男は鉄:
Every single one of them
Says things like "wood" and "stone"
How soft-hearted...

Men are iron!
That's all there is to it, right?
entries.おれをめじるしにして\nまっすぐ下に行けば 出口だ・・・\nこっちからじゃ わか:
Make me your guide,
and if you go straight down, you'll find the exit...
It's hard to understand from here, isn't it?
entries.・・・むかしは 手で回さなくても\nキカイでリフトが動いたんだけどなぁ・・・: ...Back in the day, you didn't have to turn it by hand; the lift moved with a machine...
entries.リフトにのって\nそこの真ん中の道を上に行けば\n鉄の城があるんだけど・・・:
Take the lift up
and go straight down the middle path
to reach the iron castle...
entries.もうっ・・・あのガンテツおやじ・・・\nどうして鉄の城に行かしてくれないのよ・・:
Ugh... that Gantetsu old man...
Why won't you let me go to the Iron Castle...?
entries.この国にも\n魔ブタの魔法がかかってるんだ・・・\nでも・・・どうしようもないよ:
This country too
is under the spell of the Demon Pig's magic...
But... there's nothing we can do about it, right?
entries.何か おさがしかな?・・・\nもし、鉄で何か作りたいのなら・・・\nそこのリフト:
Is there something you're looking for?...
If you want to make something out of iron...
Why don't you go to that lift shed over there?
entries.キミ・・・時計台 直したんだって?\nすごいなぁ・・・\n\nいまの この国じゃ:
You... fixed the clock tower?
That's amazing...

In this country now,
I can't even imagine...
entries.石人の時計台が鉄のハグルマで\nなおったんだって?・・・\n\nえっ? 動かない:
I heard the stone clock tower was fixed with an iron haguruma?...

Huh? It doesn't work?...
I see...
entries.鉄の城のトビラ?・・・\n\nアハハハ・・・\nそんなの\nこわせるハズないでし:
The door of the iron castle?...

Ahahahaha...
That's not something you can break, right...?
entries.おまえさん・・・\n泳ぎは とくいですかな?・・・\n\nわしは\nおもいっきり:
You...
Are you good at swimming?...

I am
completely hopeless at it...
entries.おいらも\nほんとうは むねをはって・・・\n\nここは文明の国です!って\n言:
I also
actually, I'm putting on my chest...

This is a civilized country! That's what I want to say.
entries.キ、キミ・・・\nハツデンキまで直しちゃったの?・・・\nす、すごすぎるよ・・・:
Ki, Kimi...
Did you fix the heart-shaped light bulb too?...
Su, it's amazing...
entries.木と石と鉄かぁ・・・\nやっぱ バランスが 大事だよな:
Wood, stone, and iron...
After all, balance is important, right?
entries.万年のじぃさんに\n会いに行くんだって・・・\nところで イカダは持ってるのかい:
I'm going to meet Grandpa Manen...
By the way, do you have a raft?
entries.ふーん・・・あんたスゴイんだ・・・\nバカにして悪かったね\nあやまるから また:
Hmm... you're amazing...
I'm sorry I made fun of you.
I apologize, so please come play again.
entries.まっすぐ 鉄の城\nみぎ 時計台\nひだり 加工場:
Straight Iron Castle
Right Clock Tower
Left Processing Plant
entries.・・・ひろいなぁ・・・\n前の石人の町の4倍いじょう\nあるんだって・・・:
...It's so vast...
It's more than four times the size of the previous stone town, apparently...
entries.国の中を の〜んびり おさんぽ・・・\n・・・いいねぇ・・・:
Taking a leisurely stroll through the country...
...How nice...
entries.・・・ボクも木のおうちに\nすみたいなぁ・・・: ...I also want to live in a wooden house...
entries.・・・いま、鉄の城ってのを\n見てきたんだけど・・・\nコシぬかしちゃったよ:
...I just saw something called an iron castle...
I messed up my back.
entries.もう一度 みんなで一つの国をつくれるなんて・・・\nこれも み〜んな トンバのお:
Once again, we can create a country together...
This is all thanks to everyone's kindness...
entries.ひさしぶりだなぁ トンバ・・・\nどうだい? おれたちの新しい町は?:
It's been a while, Tomba...
How's it? Our new town?
entries.・・・こ・・・この・・・鉄の冷たい\nかんしょくが 何とも・・・:
...this...this...the cold iron.
The shock is indescribable...
entries.木づくりってのも あったかみがあって\nなかなかイイもんだなぁ・・・:
There's something warm about woodworking,
and it's pretty nice...
entries.時計台も みんなで お色直ししたんだぜ・・・\n一度、見てってくれよ:
We even got the clock tower all dressed up...
You should take a look sometime.
entries.木・石・鉄・・・それぞれの素村をいかすことが\n大事だよな・・・\nま、ようは:
Wood, stone, iron... it's important to make use of each raw material village, right?
Well, basically, it's about how you use them.
entries.魔ブタがカベをつくっただけで\nみんなの気持ちがバラバラになっちまうなんて\n・:
Just because a demon pig built a wall,
it makes everyone's feelings scatter...
That's scary.
entries.ほかにも 魔ブタに魔法をかけられた所って\nあるんだろ?・・・: There must be other places where magic was cast on the demon pig, right?...
entries.んっ? \nジュースのみたいのか?\n\n・・・ちがう? \n最後の魔ブタをこら:
Hmm?
Do you want some juice?

...No?
Finally, I'll punish that devil pig!?
Alright! I'm coming too!
entries.あら?\n・・・・・・あらあらあらあらあらっ!\n\n・・・・・・かわいいボウヤ:
Huh?
...Oh my, oh my, oh my, oh my!

...What a cute little boy!

Me?
...I am Mizuno... Mizuno, the Demon King!
entries.・・・な〜に?\nボウヤも魔法のドロップがほしいの?\n\nごめんねぇ・・・\n:
...What?
You want a magic drop too?

Sorry...

I'm a little busy right now...
Can you do it yourself?

Here, stand in front of that big pot over there
And use the item you want to turn into village fees...
entries.・・・・・・しっかし\n・・・こまったなぁ・・・\n・・・どこに おきわすれたの:
...Hmm...
...This is troublesome...
...I wonder where I left them...

...But... do people usually forget things like this?
...Those precious crystal balls...
And three of them!!

...I guess I went to
...the Takami Yagura tower?
entries.あ〜あ・・・・・・\nせっかく 3つの水晶と見えないカガミで・・・\nアレを作ろ:
Ah...
I was going to make that thing with the three crystals and the invisible mirror...
But...
entries.あら?\n・・・・・・あらあらあらあらあらっ!\n\n・・・これよ これっ!\n:
Huh?
...Oh my, oh my, oh my, oh my!

...This is it! This is it!
...Why does Boya have it?

...But I was saved... Thank you, boy.
...Yo~shi~...
Finally, I can make that thing...

...What is it?
It seems like Boya is also interested?

...then, after a while.
Come again...
...it shouldn't take that long...
entries.きた きたっ!\n待ってたよ・・・ほら、これがウワサのアレ・・・\n魔法のカガミ:
Here it comes!
I've been waiting for this... Look, this is the rumored thing...
It's the magic mirror!
entries.・・・・・・・・・・ポンッ!\n・・・ほ〜ら できた・・・\n\nふたつの道具の:
...Pon!
...Here you go, it's done...

It's the completion of Dokapin, who possesses the special abilities of two tools!
entries.このカガミはさぁ・・・スゴイんだよ・・・\nなんと!\n\n道具をパワーアップし:
This mirror... it's amazing...
What?!

It can power up tools...
Boy... do you have anything?
entries.な〜んだ いいもの持ってるじゃない・・・\nふーん・・・グルドカとグルピンねぇ・:
Oh, you have something good...
Hmm... Gurdka and Gurupin, huh...

I'm seeing this for the first time too...
Alright, I'll reflect this onto the mirror...
...............

...............
...............
entries.ちなみに・・・魔法のカガミは\nアタシにしか使えないんだけど・・・\n・・・まぁ:
By the way... the magic mirror can only be used by me...
...Well, you should keep it with Kinen...
entries.は・・・は・・・\nはぁ〜れた そらぁ〜・・・\n\nあら?\n・・・なおった!:
Ha... ha...
Haa~ra, soraa~...

Oh?
...It's healed!?...

...Boy...
Even medicine for me...

...Well then, did you fall for me?
...It's Jordan, Jordan!

But, thank you so much...
Just hearing a sneeze,
Bringing me a cold medicine...

As expected...
Here!
It's nothing special, but take it.
entries.こんなトコで 寄り道してていーのかい?: Is it okay to stop by a place like this?
entries.・・・な〜に?\nボウヤも魔法のドロップがほしいの?\n・・・あまいねぇ〜\n\:
...What?
Does the boy also want a magic drop?
...How sweet~

To make a drop, you need the following village fees
!!

"Biting grass flower," right?
"Silver powder," right?
"Black honey" is essential too...

"Cockatoo claws" are also good flavor,
and "pig bug spines" might be necessary too.
"Alligator fangs" are hidden flavor!

Hey, stand in front of that big pot over there
and put in the village fee items.
entries.まだ 村料が たりないみたい・・・\nあと:
It seems like the village fee is still insufficient...
Also.
entries.かくれざと\n\nセーブしますか?\n はい→× いいえ→×:
Are you sure you want to save?
Yes → × No → ×
entries.おお、おまえ、ドワーフのことばわかるか!?\nドワーフ、とてもこまってる・・・\:
Oh, you, do you understand the Dwarvish language!?
Dwarves, they're very troubled...

Actually... this Dwarven forest,
is under the spell of the Demon Pig's magic...
The flowers and trees have also changed their forms...

Just now, seven companions were surrounded by monsters in the forest
and became lost...

Probably, inside the larger monsters,
possessed by the Hoshi,
they're unable to move...

Hurry up and open the door near the entrance to the village
and the hut in the forest,
and go deep into the forest, to the very edge...

If you can't find your companions,
they won't let you pass through the forest...
entries.・・・7人のなかま、かえってきたけど・・・\nじつは、こどもがひとり・・・\n森:
...Seven companions have returned, but...
Actually, one child is missing...
Still lost in the forest...
entries.もう、森のおくを\n見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・\n自由に通ってくだされ・・・:
You don't need to look at the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...
entries.すぴ〜すかかか・・・んがんごっ\n・・・すぴょぴょぴょ・・・:
Supi~ sukaka ka ka... ngan go.
...Supyo pyo pyo pyo...
entries.よぉ・・・\nお前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・\n\nどうだい?\nオレと ひと:
Hey...
I've been waiting for you to come...

How about it?
Wanna play a little game with me?

Actually, I've hidden a treasure at the top of the Takami Yagura tower ahead.
So here's the deal:

Start from the bottom of the Takami Yagura,
and if you reach the treasure faster than me,
I'll give you that treasure...

How about it? Sounds interesting, right?
Alright then... let's go!
entries.うわ〜 空に飛んでるトリまで \nヤキトリに見えるぅぅぅぅ・・・ \n\nほぁ・:
Wow—even the birds flying in the sky look like yakitori to me…

Huh… what do you need?

Sorry about that, I'm starving right now,
and everything looks like food to me,
so you'd better not get too close…

Ah~ I wish there was someone kind enough to share
some filling food with me…
entries.おおお! しんせつな人は\nいがいと近くに いるんだなあ!!\n\nおっとっと:
Wow! Kind people are surprisingly close by!!

Whoa, whoa, I need to say thank you before I eat,
thank you for helping me!

I'm Taro...
Oh, here, take this...
Here, a piece of cheese.
entries.何かこまった事があれば、\nいつでも た・す・け・て\n・・・くれよ!!:
If you have any trouble,
please help me anytime...
...please!!
entries.旅の人!\n\nここに来る途中\nヤンと言う子供に会いませんでした?\n\nじつ:
Traveler!

On your way here,
didn't you meet a child named Yang?

Actually, he's my son...
And what a foolish son he is...

Once he hides in hide-and-seek,
he won't come back until he's found.

I wonder if he's getting hungry by now...
Traveler, could you find Yang and
deliver this to him?
entries.かならず 息子に届けてくださいよ!!\n途中でつまみ食いしないように・・・たのみ:
Please be sure to deliver it to my son!!
Don't snack on it along the way... I'm counting on you.
entries.あなたの事は 息子のヤンから聞いてます\nトンバさんでしょ・・・\n\nあなたが:
I've heard about you from my son Yan.
You're Tongba, right...?

Because you found Yan while he was hiding during his journey,
he's now back in the village.

If you hadn't found him...
probably,
Yan would have continued playing hide-and-seek alone...

Thank you very much...
entries.またヤンが かくれんぼを始めたら、\nはやめに 見つけてやってくださいね・・・: If Yang starts playing hide-and-seek again, please find him quickly...
entries.そのべんとうは・・・\nとうさんに会ったんだね\nわざわざ 届けてくれてありがと:
That bento...
You met your father, didn't you?
Thank you for taking the trouble to deliver it.

But I'll give this one to you.
I'm not hungry anyway.

If you like, I'll give you this too.
It's nothing special, but... See ya!
entries.え・・・な、なんだって!!\nオイラのべんとうを 食べちゃったのか?\n\nオイ:
Eh... what?!
Did you eat my bento?

Hey hey, it's Joudan...
Don't worry about it!

Dad's bento is delicious though~
Well then, I'm off... Bye-bye!
entries.へぇ・・・\nここを 見つけるなんて たいしたものね・・・\nここは かくれ里っ:
Hmm...
Finding this place is quite something, isn't it...
This is called Hidden Village.
entries.ここの れんちゅうは \nかくれるのが だいすきでのぅ・・・\n\nそうじゃ、ヤ:
I really like hiding here...

So, have you met Yang yet?
entries.ここのチョウヅカには 金の・・・\n何とかって言うめずらしいものを\n守ってるら: It seems this Chouzukka protects something rare called gold...
entries.やぁ!キミが来るのを待ってたんだ\n\n・・・はじめて出会ったのをいれて\n・・:
Hey! I was waiting for you to come.

...Including the first time we met,
...I was hidden five times,

but they all found me... But,
it was fun!

Well then, here's some special information
...somewhere on this continent

there seems to be a place called the Million Tower...

Huh? Where is it?...
You have to find it yourself!

But... even if you search randomly,
you'll never find it...

You need to gather certain conditions...
And this is a present from me!

I'm sure it will be useful!
entries.風になりたい: I want to become the wind.
entries.つかわなくてよい: You don't have to use it.
entries.かえり道をわすれたカエル: The frog who forgot its way home.
entries.かえられなくなった ドワーフのこども\nなきべそをかいている: The dwarf child who could no longer be changed is crying.
entries.何でもふき飛ばす\n強力なたつまき:
Blows everything away
A powerful gale
entries.100年老人の小屋へ いつでも\nもどれる ふしぎな すず:
To the 100-year-old man's hut, anytime.
A mysterious tin.
entries.100年の宝箱を\nあけられる カギ: The key to unlocking a 100-year treasure chest.
entries.一度行った場所へ いつでも 行ける\nきちょうな はね:
You can always go to places you've been to once.
A dull feather.
entries.かみつき草にさいた\nめずらしい花:
I planted it in the grass.
A rare flower.
entries.わらい、なきを回復してくれるキノコ: A mushroom that restores laughter and tears.
entries.もれない バケツ\n水をためるには もってこい:
A bucket that won't leak.
Perfect for storing water.
entries.遠くの景色を見ることができる: You can see the distant scenery.
entries.とてもきれいな 小ビン\nなにも はいっていないようだ:
A very beautiful small bottle.
It doesn't seem to have anything in it.
entries.フラワーのナミダが つまった小ビン: A small bottle filled with flower tears.
entries.大きなミミには ふしぎな力\n一度行った所なら ひとっとび:
Big ears have a mysterious power.
Once you've been somewhere, you can jump there in an instant.
entries.枯れ葉の羽を持つ\n伝説のチョウチョ:
A butterfly with wings of withered leaves,
a legendary butterfly.
entries.水がたっぷり\nはいったバケツ: A bucket filled with plenty of water.
entries.なにも うつさないカガミ: A mirror that doesn't reflect anything.
entries.たかい所から ユラユラおりられる\nサンタのパラソル:
From a high place, you can sway down
Santa's parasol
entries.木で できた かるい\nブーメラン: A light boomerang made of wood.
entries.イシで できた おもい\nブーメラン れんしゃできる:
A thought made of stone.
I can shoot a boomerang.
entries.コウテツで できた 強力な\nブーメラン 3れんしゃできる: A powerful boomerang made of kouetsu can be used three times.
entries.ガンガン ぶっとばせ!\n動きがさらに はやくなるパンツ:
Go all out!
Pants that make your movements even faster.
entries.せかいを 見わたす\nべんりな 地図: A convenient map that covers the world.
entries.めずらしいつぼだが われている\nさいきんわれたようだ:
It's a rare pot, but it's broken.
It seems to have been broken recently.
entries.さいしょからもっているブキ\nてきをけちらす:
The weapon I had from the beginning.
To scatter enemies.
entries.はじめから はいている\nパンツ:
I've been wearing them from the beginning.
Pants.
entries.ささると ブラさがれる\nたのもしいアイテム:
When you get caught, you'll be exposed.
A fearsome item.
entries.グルドカとグルピンの のうりょくをもつ\n強力なブキ: A powerful weapon possessing the power of Gurdka and Gurupin.
entries.シリモモのガスを あびて\n小さくなった コマブタ:
Bathed in the gas of Shirimomo,
the small piglet.
entries.1000年の宝箱を\nあけられる カギ: The key that can open the 1000-year treasure chest.
entries.風のたに に魔法をかけた\n赤の魔ブタを封じる力をもつ:
I cast magic on the wind's edge,
possessing the power to seal the red demon pig.
entries.バッカスの村に魔法をかけた\nオレンジの魔ブタを封じる力をもつ:
I cast a spell on the village of Bacchus.
It has the power to seal the orange demon pig.
entries.からくり村に魔法をかけた\n黄の魔ブタを封じる力をもつ:
I cast magic on the Karakuri Village.
It has the power to seal the Yellow Demon Pig.
entries.マグマのどうくつに魔法をかけた\n緑の魔ブタを封じる力をもつ:
I cast magic on the magma's earthquake.
It has the power to seal green demon pigs.
entries.ドワーフの森に魔法をかけた\n青の魔ブタを封じる力をもつ:
I cast magic on the Dwarf Forest.
It has the power to seal the blue demon pig.
entries.ジャングルに魔法をかけた\nコンの魔ブタを封じる力をもつ:
I cast magic on the jungle.
It has the power to seal Con's demon pig.
entries.シーフマンションに魔法をかけた\nピンクの魔ブタを封じる力をもつ:
I cast magic on the Seif Mansion.
It has the power to seal pink demon pigs.
entries.万年の宝箱を\nあけられる カギ: The key that can open the treasure chest of eternity.
entries.億年の宝箱を\nあけられる カギ: The key that can open the billion-year treasure chest.
entries.カギの一部が見える\nどこかにはめるようだが?:
I can see part of the key.
It seems like it should be fitted somewhere?
entries.パワーぎれも いっきに解決できる\nありがたい アイテム:
Power outages can be solved instantly.
A truly helpful item.
entries.雨雲を呼んで 雨をふらせる\n奇跡のアイテム:
Calling rain clouds and making it rain.
A miracle item.
entries.大きなカギ穴を持つ トビラをひらく\n大きなカギ:
Opening a door with a large keyhole.
A large key.
entries.小さなカギ穴を持つ トビラをひらく\n小さなカギ:
Opening a door with a small keyhole.
A small key.
entries.たくさん 集めると いい物がもらえる\nうれしい アイテム:
Collecting many will earn you good items.
Happy items.
entries.魔王にしかつかえない\n魔法のカガミ:
Only usable by the Demon King.
Magic Mirror.
entries.世界をえがいた 大きな 地図の半分: Half of a large map depicting the world
entries.あぶない物を持っても\n平気な 手ぶくろ:
Even holding dangerous things,
these gloves are fine.
entries.大きな 物でも ふきとばす\nたのもしい アイテム:
Even large objects can be blown away.
A powerful item.
entries.じょうぶな どうぐが つくれそうな\n鉄のかたまり: A lump of iron that seems like it could make a strong tool.
entries.どんな 花が さくのか\n楽しみな タネ:
What kind of flowers will bloom?
A fun seed.
entries.モレ知らずの べんりな バルブ: A convenient valve that doesn't leak.
entries.かおりだけで 酔ってしまいそうな\nアルコール: An alcohol that makes you feel drunk just from its scent.
entries.どこかにさくという めずらしい花\n大トリのこうぶつ:
A rare flower called "saku" somewhere.
The grand finale animal.
entries.万年老人から たのまれた\n1とかかれた 玉:

messages.original:
この土地は はじめてか?

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

でも、このあたりもあぶなくなったから
気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と○ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!

この先に行きたいのかい?

そりゃぁムリだ・・・
この先はキリで まっ白だぜ

キリがなくなりゃぁ
行けるんだけどな・・・
messages.translation:
Hey, Niichan too,
do you want to go further?

That's impossible...
Beyond this point, it's completely white.

If the Kiri runs out,
you can go, though...

messages.original:
まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば
何とかなるみたいだけど・・・
じっさい どこにあるんだよ、そんなもん・・・

オレは あきらめた!
にぃちゃんも考えた方がいいぜ・・・

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Well, according to what I heard, if there's a violent tornado,
it seems like we can manage somehow...
But seriously, where on earth is something like that...?

I've given up!
You should think about it too, big brother...

Goodbye!

messages.original: ちょっと まてよ
ウワッ!やめろョ

オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ
何か たべるもん ないか?・・・
なけりゃ またあとにしてくれョ
messages.translation:
I'm hungry right now and I'm getting irritated.
Is there anything I can eat?...
If not, please save it for later.

messages.original:
オ〜〜〜ッ!
なんだ それくれるのか?

サンキュー! たすかったゼ
もう ハラがへって、うごけなかったんだ

オレ サンタ ってんだ、よろしくな
messages.translation:
Ohhhh!
What? You're giving me that?

Thanks! That saved me.
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa—nice to meet you.

messages.original:
そうだ!!
とっておきの技をおしえてやるョ

いいか?
messages.translation:
That's right!!
I'll teach you my secret technique!

Is that okay?

人よんで ケモノダッシュっていう技だゼ
messages.translation: Pressing the X button while running makes your speed increase—it's called "Kemono Dash," a technique used by humans.

messages.original: サンキュ
バイバイ・・・

・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!

かくれてたんだけど よくわかったな・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh dear... I've already been found!

I was hiding, but you figured it out so well...

messages.original:
よし! いいことおしえてやるよ

この小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるいけ、
そして、この小屋の先を上に行くと
100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ
messages.translation:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

If you go straight to the back of this hut, there's a gate,
And if you go up past this hut,
There's an old man called the 100-year-old living there.

messages.original:
え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・
そんなことより まず行ってみろよ、
ウソじゃないから・・・

そのあとで また会おうや
messages.translation:
Huh?... Is that me?...
Rather than that, first go and see it,
It's not a lie...

After that, let's meet again.

messages.original: えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・

100年老人には会ったのかい?

会ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you met the 100-year-old?

If you do, let's meet again.

messages.original:
ふるいけ には行ったかい?

行ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Did you go to Furuike?

If you did, let's meet again.

messages.original:
どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ

じまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってんだ
messages.translation:
How about it, it wasn't a lie, right?

It's not a joke, but I know a lot.

messages.original:
・・・あぁ、オイラかい?

オイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・
messages.translation:
...Ah, me?

I'm Yan, from the Hidden Village...

messages.original:
いつも かくれてるんだけど、
だれも見つけられないんだ・・・

また見つけられたら そのときも
いいことおしえてやるよ!
・・・見つけることができたらな
messages.translation:
I always hide,
but no one can find me...

If I can be found again,
I'll tell you something good then too!
...If I can be found.

messages.original:
う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・
がんばって見つけてくれよ

じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Hmm... I'm starting to feel like I'm having fun now...
Please do your best to find it!

See ya!

messages.original:
この先に行く気か?

でも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?
messages.translation:
Are you going to go ahead?

But… can you swim?

messages.original:
いかん、いかん

今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが
次からそうはいかん

そこのトビラの先は
泳げないと行けんのだから・・・

悪いことはいわん、
今はやめた方がいい・・・

いつか 泳げるようになってから行くんだナ

おっ そうだ!
おまえ ハラへってないかィ?

これ もってけよ!
messages.translation:
No, no.

I got help from the turtle this time,
but I can't do that again next time.

Beyond that door,

messages.original:
この土地は はじめてか?

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と○ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!

なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

でも、このあたりもあぶなくなったから
気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と×ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the vertical scrollbar.
When looking, use the ↑ and × buttons.

...See ya!

この先に行きたいのかい?

そりゃぁムリだ・・・
この先はキリで まっ白だぜ

キリがなくなりゃぁ
行けるんだけどな・・・
messages.translation:
Hey, Niichan too,
do you want to go further?

That's impossible...
Beyond this point, it's completely white.

If the Kiri runs out,
you can go, though...

messages.original:
まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば
何とかなるみたいだけど・・・
じっさい どこにあるんだよ、そんなもん・・・

オレは あきらめた!
にぃちゃんも考えた方がいいぜ・・・

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Well, according to what I heard, if there's a violent tornado,
it seems like we can manage somehow...
But seriously, where on earth is something like that...?

I've given up!
You should think about it too, big brother...

Goodbye!

messages.original: ちょっと まてよ
ウワッ!やめろョ

オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ
何か たべるもん ないか?・・・
なけりゃ またあとにしてくれョ
messages.translation:
I'm hungry right now and I'm getting irritated.
Is there anything I can eat?...
If not, please save it for later.

messages.original:
オ〜〜〜ッ!
なんだ それくれるのか?

サンキュー! たすかったゼ
もう ハラがへって、うごけなかったんだ

オレ サンタ ってんだ、よろしくな
messages.translation:
Ohhhh!
What? You're giving me that?

Thanks! That saved me.
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa—nice to meet you.

messages.original:
そうだ!!
とっておきの技をおしえてやるョ

いいか?
messages.translation:
That's right!!
I'll teach you my secret technique!

Is that okay?

messages.original:
×ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、
人よんで ケモノダッシュっていう技だゼ
messages.translation: Pressing the X button while running makes your speed increase—it's called "Kemono Dash," a technique used by humans.

じゃぁオレはいくゼ

あばよ!
messages.translation:

Well then, I'm off!

Goodbye!

messages.original: サンキュ
バイバイ・・・

・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!

かくれてたんだけど よくわかったな・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh dear... I've already been found!

I was hiding, but you figured it out so well...

messages.original:
よし! いいことおしえてやるよ

この小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるいけ、
そして、この小屋の先を上に行くと
100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ
messages.translation:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

If you go straight to the back of this hut, there's a gate,
And if you go up past this hut,
There's an old man called the 100-year-old living there.

messages.original:
え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・
そんなことより まず行ってみろよ、
ウソじゃないから・・・

そのあとで また会おうや
messages.translation:
Huh?... Is that me?...
Rather than that, first go and see it,
It's not a lie...

After that, let's meet again.

messages.original: えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・

100年老人には会ったのかい?

会ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you met the 100-year-old?

If you do, let's meet again.

messages.original:
ふるいけ には行ったかい?

行ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Did you go to Furuike?

If you did, let's meet again.

messages.original:
どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ

じまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってんだ
messages.translation:
How about it, it wasn't a lie, right?

It's not a joke, but I know a lot.

messages.original:
・・・あぁ、オイラかい?

オイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・
messages.translation:
...Ah, me?

I'm Yan, from the Hidden Village...

messages.original:
いつも かくれてるんだけど、
だれも見つけられないんだ・・・

また見つけられたら そのときも
いいことおしえてやるよ!
・・・見つけることができたらな
messages.translation:
I always hide,
but no one can find me...

If I can be found again,
I'll tell you something good then too!
...If I can be found.

messages.original:
う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・
がんばって見つけてくれよ

じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Hmm... I'm starting to feel like I'm having fun now...
Please do your best to find it!

See ya!

messages.original:
この先に行く気か?

でも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?
messages.translation:
Are you going to go ahead?

But… can you swim?

messages.original:
いかん、いかん

今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが
次からそうはいかん

そこのトビラの先は
泳げないと行けんのだから・・・

悪いことはいわん、
今はやめた方がいい・・・

いつか 泳げるようになってから行くんだナ

おっ そうだ!
おまえ ハラへってないかィ?

これ もってけよ!
messages.translation:
No, no.

I got help from the turtle this time,
but I can't do that again next time.

Beyond that door,
you can't go unless you can swim...

Don't say bad things,
it's better to stop now...

I'll go when I can swim someday.

Oh, right!
Are you hungry?

Take this!

messages.original: じゃあなボウズ 気ィつけて行けや

おおっ! おまえ およげるんかィ
・・・でも、ここには カギが かかっててな、
いまのところ 向こう側にはいけないんだ・・・
messages.translation:
Wow! You can swim, huh?
...But there's a lock here, so I can't get to the other side right now...

messages.original:
ん〜っ・・・見たところ 文明の国にいる
鉄人の作ったカギみたいだけどナ・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm... from what I can see, it's in a civilized country.
It looks like a key made by an iron man, but na...

messages.original:
な〜んだ 持ってたんかィ・・・
でも、気ィつけて行けよ・・・

おれは、キノコの森近くの浜道で ふねにのってるから
気が向いたら のぞいてくれや

おっ そうだ! ハラへってないかィ? 
これ、もってけよ
messages.translation:
Oh, you had it...
But be careful when you go...

I'm on a boat near the beach road near the mushroom forest,
so if you feel like it, take a peek.

Oh, right! Are you hungry?
Take this.

messages.original:
ダートモトクロスレース
レッツ チャレンジ!!

木の枝にぶらさがると 大回転ができる!
方向キー◀か→ を押しつづけると 回転する
逆回転したいときは 逆の方向キーを押す
messages.translation:
When hanging from a tree branch, you can do a big spin!
Press and hold the direction key ◀ or → to spin.
To reverse the rotation, press the opposite direction key.

messages.original:
ジャンプしたい方向の方向キーを 押しながら
×ボタンを 押して ジャンプ!!

×ボタンを 押す時間で ジャンプ距離が変わる
タイミングは まったく 関係なし!!
messages.translation:
Press the direction key for the direction you want to jump while pressing the × button to jump!!
The jump distance changes depending on how long you press the × button.
Timing doesn't matter at all!!

百識の木の実をつかった

messages.original: 浜道の近草をつかった
messages.translation: I used the near grass of the beach road.

messages.original: カギがかかっている
ケモノダッシュ
カエルがにげた
1UP
バイタリティ1ぞうか
ポテンシャル 先 MAX!!
あ
ウッキーパラソルをしまった
超能魚をしまった
messages.translation: I put away the superpower fish.

messages.original: 秘宝魚をしまった
アイテムをつかった

・・・うーん・・・こまったのォ・・・

どーしたもんかのォ・・・

んっ?
messages.translation:
...Hmm... I'm in trouble...

What should I do...?

Hmm?

messages.original:
なんじゃ?・・・
わしが100年老人じゃが・・・何か用かな?
messages.translation:
What is it?...
I am a 100-year-old old man... Is there something you need?

messages.original:
すまんが、ちょっと
考えごとをしておってな・・・・・・

・・・おお そうじゃ!!
ちょっと おまえさん、たのまれてくれんか?
たのみというのはのォ・・・

おまえさんも ここへ来るとき 見たと思うが、
赤いトリのコッカのやつめ、

よそからタマゴを盗んできては、
ああやって自分のものにしておってな・・・

あのままでは
中のヒナが かわいそうなんじゃ・・・

そこでおまえさん、このへんにあるタマゴの中にいる
ヒナを全部 集めてくれんか?
messages.translation:
Sorry, I'm just thinking about something...

...Oh, that's right!
Hey, would you do me a favor?
What I mean by "favor" is...

You probably saw it when you came here,
that red-breasted chick,

stealing eggs from other places
and then making them his own...

If things continue like this,
the chicks inside will be pitiful...

So, could you gather all the chicks
inside the eggs around here?

messages.original:
しんぱいじゃからな・・・
たのんだぞ
messages.translation:
I'm worried...
I'm counting on you.

messages.original:
なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか?

ん〜〜〜っ・・・
じゃが まだ残っとるようじゃのォ・・・

すまんがもう一度 行ってくれんか?
messages.translation:
What? Are they already gathering?

Hmm~~~...
But it seems like there's still some left...

Sorry, could you go again?

messages.original:
集めてくれたのか?・・・
ん〜〜〜っ・・・

じゃが まだ残っとるようじゃのォ・・・
すまんがもう一度 行ってくれんか?
messages.translation:
Did you collect them?...
Hmmmmm...

But it seems there's still some left...
Sorry, but could you go again?

messages.original:
なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか・・・
おおぉぉぉっ!しかも全部集まっとるではないか!
・・・・・・で、中身はどこじゃ?
messages.translation:
What? Already gathered...?
Ohhhhh! And they're all gathered!
...And where are the contents?

messages.original:
おー・まい・がっ!!

ハラの中に入れとったのか!?

まぁ、しかし 消化はされとらんようじゃし、
よしとするかのォ

いやぁ、何はともあれ ごくろうじゃった
・・・これで わしも安心じゃわい

んっ?・・・・・・そうじゃそうじゃ
わしに何か用が あったようじゃな

・・・・・・ほう・・・・・・
コマブタに おジィさんの形見のうでわを
とられたのか・・・

それで コマブタたちのことを
ききたいんじゃな・・・

んっ わかった・・・
じつはのォ・・・・・・・・・・・・
messages.translation:
Oh my god!!

Did you put it in the stomach!?

Well, but it doesn't seem to be digested,
so I'll leave it at that.

Well, anyway, it was exhausting.
...With this, I can rest easy.

Hmm?...That's right, that's right.
It seems like there was something you wanted from me.

...Hmm...
Did Komabuta take the memento of Ojiisan's arm...?

So, you want to ask about Komabuta and the others...

Hmm, I understand...
Actually, no...

messages.original:
集めてくれたのか?

・・・おぉっ!! 全部集まったようじゃな
・・・・・・で、中身はどこじゃ?
messages.translation:
Did you gather them?

...Oh! It looks like everything's been collected.
...And where are the contents?

messages.original:
わしが話してやれる事はここまでじゃ・・・

もしおまえさんがこの先の方を進むのなら、
わしの仲間をさがしてみるといい、
きっと力になってくれるはずじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
This is as far as I can go in telling you...

If you're going to move forward from here,
you should try looking for my companions,
and I'm sure they'll be able to help you...

messages.original:
あとは・・・ そうじゃな・・・

アイテムを 手にいれたら・・
「アイテム」コマンドの「みる」を えらんで
じっくり ながめてみるようにな・・・

きっと、なにか気づくことがあるはずじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
After that... well...

Once you get an item...
Select "View" from the "Item" command,
and take your time looking at it carefully...

Surely, you'll notice something...

messages.original:
おや?ないのぉ・・・
おまえさんに100年のすずを
やろうとおもったんじゃが・・・

どこかで無くしてしまったようじゃな・・・

もし、それらしい物をみつけたら
持ってきておくれ・・・

そのかわり、おまえさんには・・・
ホレ、これをやろう・・・100年のカギじゃ
messages.translation:
Oh? It's gone...
I was going to give you a hundred years of tin...

It seems like you lost it somewhere...

If you find something like it,
bring it to me...

In exchange, I'll give you this... Here, take this—it's a hundred-year key.

messages.original:
これで、ここにあるのとおなじ宝箱なら
あけることができるようになったはずじゃ・・・
ん〜ラッキーじゃのぉ・・・
messages.translation:
With this, you should now be able to open the same treasure chests as the ones here...
Hmm, what luck!

messages.original:
それと・・・魔ブタをさがすには、
封印ぶくろ と呼ばれるモノが必要じゃ・・・

それがないと、
かくれ場所が目に見えんようになっとるんじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
And... to find the Demon Pig, you need something called a Seal Pouch...

Without it,
the hiding place becomes invisible...

messages.original:
封印ぶくろのことは、この先の森に住む
ドワーフの長老にきいてみるといい・・・
もっとくわしくおしえてくれるはずじゃ
messages.translation:
As for the sealed bag, you should ask the elder of the dwarves who live in the forest ahead...
They should be able to tell you more about it.

messages.original:
・・・まだまだ先は長い・・・
あせってケガなど せんようにな・・・
messages.translation:
...The road ahead is still long...
Don't rush and get injured...

messages.original:
・・・おおっ、これはまさしく100年のすず!
よく見つけたのぉ・・・

これをつかえばいつでも、
ここに戻って来ることができるはずじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh wow, this is exactly 100 years of Suzu!
You found it well...

If you use this, you should be able to come back here anytime...

messages.original: ・・・おおっ、かえってきたか

よく やったのぉ・・・・・・

これで この大陸も もとの静けさを
とりもどすじゃろう・・・・・・
messages.translation:
Well done…

With this, this continent will regain its original tranquility…

messages.original:
ふん! 
まぁ、マグレじゃろうけどな・・・
messages.translation:
Hmph!
Well, it's probably just a fluke...

messages.original:
ほっ ほっ ほっ・・・
何を言うとる・・・

いちばん心配しとったクセに・・・
素直じゃないのぉ・・・
messages.translation:
Ho ho ho...
What are you saying...?

You were the most worried, weren't you...?
You're not being honest, are you...?

messages.original:
なっ! 何を・・・
別に わしは心配なんか・・・・・・
messages.translation:
What! What are you...
I'm not worried about anything...

messages.original:
まぁまぁ・・・
・・・ともかく・・・

この少年の勇気が 
皆を救ってくれたんじゃ
messages.translation:
Well, well...
...Anyway...

This boy's courage
saved everyone, didn't it?

messages.original:
・・・そうじゃな・・・・
・・で?
おまえさんの目的は はたせたのかな?

・・・・・
・・・・そうか
・・・よかったのう
messages.translation:
...That's right...
...And?
Did you achieve your goal?

...
...I see.
...That's good.

messages.original:
何じゃ・・・
もう行ってしまうのか?

・・・そうか・・・

・・・わしら時の老人は トンバとともにある・・・
・・・何かあったら、また たずねてきなさい
messages.translation:
...I see...

...Our old man is with Tomba...
...If anything happens, come visit us again.

messages.original: たっしゃでな・・・

げ・・・元気でな・・・

気をつけてかえれよ・・・

カゼひくなよ・・・

え〜っと、それから・・・・・・
messages.translation:
Be careful on your way home...

Don't catch a cold...

Um, and also...

messages.original:
まったく・・・
自分のマゴに話してるみたいじゃな・・・
ほっ ほっ ほっ・・・
messages.translation:
Seriously...
It feels like I'm talking to my own mago...
Ho ho ho...

messages.original: ・・・恵みコゾウが復活すると、幻の塔が現れる・・・
messages.translation: ...When the Blessing Kozo revives, the Phantom Tower will appear...

messages.original:
・・・ドワーフの集落に花の種をまくと、
   金色の花がさく・・・
messages.translation:
...When you sow flower seeds in the dwarven village,
golden flowers bloom...

messages.original: ・・・山の頂上には、かくれた村がある・・・
messages.translation: ...At the top of the mountain, there is a hidden village...

messages.original:
・・・ウワサを聞いた後、納屋のある小屋に
   魔王がかえってくる・・・
messages.translation: ...After hearing the rumor, the Demon King returns to the shed where the barn is located...

messages.original:
この土地は はじめてか?

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

でも、このあたりもあぶなくなったから
気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と○ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

でも、このあたりもあぶなくなったから
気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と○ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this land new to you?

I used to live here before,
but things have changed a lot since then.

I don't know what it is, but if you want to know something,
there's a cabin way up ahead.

Meet the 100-year-old old man and ask him.

But things around here have gotten dangerous,
so be careful.

Oh, right! Look at the foot pedals.
When looking, use the ↑ and ○ buttons.

...See ya!

よぉ、にィちゃんも
この先に行きたいのかい?

そりゃぁムリだ・・・
この先はキリで まっ白だぜ

キリがなくなりゃぁ
行けるんだけどな・・・
messages.translation:
Hey, Niichan too,
do you want to go further?

That's impossible...
Beyond this point, it's completely white.

If the Kiri runs out,
you can go, though...

messages.original:
まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば
何とかなるみたいだけど・・・
じっさい どこにあるんだよ、そんなもん・・・

オレは あきらめた!
にぃちゃんも考えた方がいいぜ・・・

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Well, according to what I heard, if there's a violent tornado,
it seems like we can manage somehow...
But seriously, where on earth is something like that...?

I've given up!
You should think about it too, big brother...

Goodbye!

messages.original: ちょっと まてよ
ウワッ!やめろョ

オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ
何か たべるもん ないか?・・・
なけりゃ またあとにしてくれョ
messages.translation:
I'm hungry right now and I'm getting irritated.
Is there anything I can eat?...
If not, please save it for later.

messages.original:
オ〜〜〜ッ!
なんだ それくれるのか?

サンキュー! たすかったゼ
もう ハラがへって、うごけなかったんだ

オレ サンタ ってんだ、よろしくな
messages.translation:
Ohhhh!
What? You're giving me that?

Thanks! That saved me.
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa—nice to meet you.

messages.original:
そうだ!!
とっておきの技をおしえてやるョ

いいか?
messages.translation:
That's right!!
I'll teach you my secret technique!

Is that okay?

messages.original:
×ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、
人よんで ケモノダッシュっていう技だゼ
messages.translation: Pressing the X button while running makes your speed increase—it's called "Kemono Dash," a technique used by humans.

messages.original:
おぼえたか?
×ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・
じゃぁオレはいくゼ

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Did you remember?
While pressing the X button...
Well then, I'm off!

Goodbye!

messages.original: サンキュ
バイバイ・・・

・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!

かくれてたんだけど よくわかったな・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh dear... I've already been found!

I was hiding, but you figured it out so well...

messages.original:
よし! いいことおしえてやるよ

この小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるいけ、
そして、この小屋の先を上に行くと
100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ
messages.translation:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

If you go straight to the back of this hut, there's a gate,
And if you go up past this hut,
There's an old man called the 100-year-old living there.

messages.original:
え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・
そんなことより まず行ってみろよ、
ウソじゃないから・・・

そのあとで また会おうや
messages.translation:
Huh?... Is that me?...
Rather than that, first go and see it,
It's not a lie...

After that, let's meet again.

messages.original: えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・

100年老人には会ったのかい?

会ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you met the 100-year-old?

If you do, let's meet again.

messages.original:
ふるいけ には行ったかい?

行ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Did you go to Furuike?

If you did, let's meet again.

messages.original:
どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ

じまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってんだ
messages.translation:
How about it, it wasn't a lie, right?

It's not a joke, but I know a lot.

messages.original:
・・・あぁ、オイラかい?

オイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・
messages.translation:
...Ah, me?

I'm Yan, from the Hidden Village...

messages.original:
いつも かくれてるんだけど、
だれも見つけられないんだ・・・

また見つけられたら そのときも
いいことおしえてやるよ!
・・・見つけることができたらな
messages.translation:
I always hide,
but no one can find me...

If I can be found again,
I'll tell you something good then too!
...If I can be found.

messages.original:
う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・
がんばって見つけてくれよ

じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Hmm... I'm starting to feel like I'm having fun now...
Please do your best to find it!

See ya!

messages.original:
この先に行く気か?

でも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?
messages.translation:
Are you going to go ahead?

But… can you swim?

messages.original:
いかん、いかん

今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが
次からそうはいかん

そこのトビラの先は
泳げないと行けんのだから・・・

悪いことはいわん、
今はやめた方がいい・・・

いつか 泳げるようになってから行くんだナ

おっ そうだ!
おまえ ハラへってないかィ?

これ もってけよ!
messages.translation:
No, no.

I got help from the turtle this time,
but I can't do that again next time.

Beyond that door,
you can't go unless you can swim...

Don't say bad things,
it's better to stop now...

I'll go when I can swim someday.

Oh, right!
Are you hungry?

Take this!

messages.original: じゃあなボウズ 気ィつけて行けや

おおっ! おまえ およげるんかィ
・・・でも、ここには カギが かかっててな、
いまのところ 向こう側にはいけないんだ・・・
messages.translation:
Wow! You can swim, huh?
...But there's a lock here, so I can't get to the other side right now...

messages.original:
ん〜っ・・・見たところ 文明の国にいる
鉄人の作ったカギみたいだけどナ・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm... from what I can see, it's in a civilized country.
It looks like a key made by an iron man, but na...

messages.original:
な〜んだ 持ってたんかィ・・・
でも、気ィつけて行けよ・・・

おれは、キノコの森近くの浜道で ふねにのってるから
気が向いたら のぞいてくれや

おっ そうだ! ハラへってないかィ? 
これ、もってけよ
messages.translation:
Oh, you had it...
But be careful when you go...

I'm on a boat near the beach road near the mushroom forest,
so if you feel like it, take a peek.

Oh, right! Are you hungry?
Take this.

messages.original:
ダートモトクロスレース
レッツ チャレンジ!!

木の枝にぶらさがると 大回転ができる!
方向キー◀か→ を押しつづけると 回転する
逆回転したいときは 逆の方向キーを押す
messages.translation:
When hanging from a tree branch, you can do a big spin!
Press and hold the direction key ◀ or → to spin.
To reverse the rotation, press the opposite direction key.

messages.original:
ジャンプしたい方向の方向キーを 押しながら
×ボタンを 押して ジャンプ!!

×ボタンを 押す時間で ジャンプ距離が変わる
タイミングは まったく 関係なし!!
messages.translation:
Press the direction key for the direction you want to jump while pressing the × button to jump!!
The jump distance changes depending on how long you press the × button.
Timing doesn't matter at all!!

messages.translation: I used Kazegusuri, which I often listen to.

Hyakka Forest

Guragura Pier

Takami Yagura

う△ーー○!!
うわーーっ!!
いてぇーーーっ!!

よぉ!びっくりしたかい?
・・・オレは、カレハチョウを
集めてるんだ・・・

ウワサによると、カレハチョウには
ふしぎな力があって・・・

何匹か集めるとスゴイことが
おこるらしいゼ・・・

何がおこるか、もし見たいんだったら、
つかまえた カレハチョウを
このムシカゴの中に入れてくれよ
messages.translation:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting butterflies...

According to rumors, butterflies have
mysterious powers...

If you collect a few, something amazing
seems to happen...

If you want to see what happens,
put the butterflies you caught
inside this Mukashio.

messages.original:
なんだ・・・もう
もってたのか・・・
messages.translation:
What... already?
Did you have it...?

messages.original:
ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今2匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
Hii... fuu... mi...
There are about two butterflies now...

messages.original:
ん?・・・やけに
さわがしいなぁ・・・
な!?・・・何だ、何だ?
messages.translation: What!?... What is it, what is it?

messages.original:
う・・・ うわーーーっ!

たすけてーーーっ!!

・・・おりれなくなっちゃった

花の種をさがしにきたんだけど・・・
どこにもないんだ・・・

かえりたいよぉ・・・
messages.translation:
...I can't go back anymore.

I came looking for flower seeds, but...
I can't find any anywhere...

I want to go home...

messages.original:
・・・おにいちゃん、
つれてってくれるの?
・・・・・・ありがとう!
messages.translation:
...Big brother,
will you take me?
...Thank you!

messages.original:
・・・おにいちゃん、
そっちじゃないとおもうよ
messages.translation:
...Older brother,
I don't think it's that way.

messages.original: いたか?

いや・・・
どこにもいない
messages.translation:
No...
He's nowhere to be found.

messages.original:
やはり、
ただのウワサか?

いや、それ
わからない・・・

でも、このもりで
見たドワーフいる
messages.translation:
No, that...
I don't know...

But, in this forest,
there's a dwarf I saw.

messages.original:
でも、いくら 大ドロボウでも
こんなところまでぬけ方つくるのは、とても大変・・・
messages.translation:
But even for a big thief,
it's very difficult to make an escape route like this...

messages.original:
・・・もういちど、
地下ロウみにいく

・・・うわぁっ!!!
・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・
なんだ、いつかのガキか・・・
messages.translation:
...Whoa!!!
...B-...I was startled...
Oh, it's that kid from before...

messages.original:
い、いやぁ・・・
やっと、ここから出してもらえてさぁ・・・
け、けっして ぬけ出したわけじゃないぞ・・・
じゃぁ、オレはこれで・・・
messages.translation:
I, no...
Finally, I've been let out of here...
I, I didn't escape at all...
Well then, I'll be going now...

messages.original:
よぉ・・・お前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・
どうだい?オレと ひとしょうぶしないか?
messages.translation:
Hey… I was waiting for you to come…
How about it? Want to hang out with me?

messages.original:
じつは、この先の高見ヤグラのてっぺんに
ある宝をかくしておいたんだ

そこでだ、高見ヤグラの下からスタートして、
オレより早く宝にたどりついたら
その宝はお前にやるよ・・・

どうだい、おもしろそうだろう?
messages.translation:
Actually, I've hidden a treasure at the very top of Takami Yagura ahead.
So, starting from the bottom of Takami Yagura,
if you reach the treasure faster than me,
I'll give that treasure to you...

How about it, doesn't sound interesting?

messages.original: じゃ・・・いくゼ!
よーい・・・どん!

はぁ・・・はぁ・・・
お前さん はやいなぁ・・・

しょうがない、オレのまけだ・・・
そのお宝はお前さんにやるよ・・・
messages.translation:
Haa... haa...
You're fast, aren't you...

It can't be helped, it's my defeat...
I'll give that treasure to you...

messages.original:
いやぁ、ひさしぶりに
たのしかったゼ
・・・じゃあ、アバヨ!
messages.translation:
Wow, it's been a while since I had fun...
Well then, bye!

messages.original:
どうやら、オレの
かち みたいだな・・・

ん? なんだい、くやしそうなカオだな・・・
まぁ、オレはどうせ ヒマだからな・・・

もう一度チャレンジしたくなったら、
いつでもオレに はなしかけてくれ
messages.translation:
Hmm? What's wrong? You look frustrated...
Well, I'm just bored anyway...

If you ever want to try again,
feel free to talk to me anytime.

messages.original:
よし! リトライだな・・・
じゃあ、下におりようか・・・
messages.translation:
Alright! Time for a retry...
Well then, let's go down...

messages.original:
あの鳥、ケガしてるみたいで
あそこからおりられないんだ
messages.translation:
That bird seems to be injured,
and it can't get down from there.

messages.original:
あの鳥、
もどってきちゃったね
messages.translation:
That bird,
it came back, didn't it?

messages.original:
この鳥 ケガしてるね・・・
・・・かわいそう・・・

このさき嵐の山・・・

いつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・
わし、長老にいわれて ここ、見はってる・・・
・・・けど、とてもたいくつ・・・

だから、いつもここで れんしゅうしてる
えっ?何のれんしゅうか?

・・・・・・じつは、わし役者になるのがゆめ・・・
役者になって、みんなを笑わせたり、
泣かせたり してみたい・・・

でも、れんしゅう とてもたいへん・・・
どんなカオすれば みんなかんどうするのか・・・
messages.translation:
This mountain ahead...

It's always windy, a very dangerous mountain...
I'm watching here, as told by the elder...
...but it's very boring...

So, I always practice here.
Huh? What kind of practice?

...Actually, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practice is very difficult...
What kind of face will make everyone feel...

messages.original:
おおっ!そのカオ、
そのひょうじょう・・・とてもいい!!

・・・なるほど
・・・ふむふむ
・・・んーとても さんこうになる
messages.translation:
Oh! That Kao,
that hyojou... very good!!

...I see
...Hmm hmm
...Hmm, it will become very sankou.

messages.original:
・・・う〜ん
・・・でも、まだ何か足りない・・・

たとえば・・・
人に かなしみをつたえるには
どんなカオすればいいのか?・・・
messages.translation:
...Hmm...
...But something is still missing...

For example...
To convey sadness to people,
what kind of kao should I do?...

messages.original:
ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!
そ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・
・・・そうか・・・

さっきの笑がおと、いまの泣きがおをマスターして・・・
ふむふむ・・・
・・・んーーーーーーっ

見えた!!
うん!ありがとう!! 

キミのおかげで何かつかめそうな気がする!
おっと、こうしちゃいられない
・・・今から とっくんだ!!
messages.translation:
Huh?... Whoa!
That, that Kaoshi filled with love! ...
...I see...

I mastered the laughter from earlier and the crying from now...
Hmm... hmm...
...nnn

I saw it!!
Yeah! Thanks!!

I feel like I can grasp something thanks to you!
Oops, I can't stay like this.
...From now on, it's over!!

messages.original:
おっと、わすれてた・・・
さっき、長老、山の方へ入っていった・・・

何でも、キミに用があるらしい・・・
はやく行ったほうがいいよ
messages.translation:
Oops, I forgot...
Just now, the elder went towards the mountains...

Apparently, he has something to say to you...
You should go quickly.

messages.original:
立ち入り禁止
この森には怪物がすんでいます。

キケンですので立ち入らないで下さい
バッカス村しぜんかんりきょく
messages.translation:
No entry allowed.
This forest is inhabited by monsters.

Please do not enter as it is dangerous.
Bacchus Village Nature Conservation Office.

messages.original:
おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・
花のナミダ、めぐみさまの復活にかかせない・・・

でも・・・
どうやってナミダ、集めるのかわからない・・・
messages.translation:
I came to collect the flower tears...
The flower tears, they are essential for Megumi-sama's revival...

But...
I don't know how to collect the tears...

messages.original: ・・・こまった・・・
ここ、めぐみの広場・・・

高見ヤグラの下のほう、
木でできてるところ・・・

こわれやすいから
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
The lower part of the Takami Yagura,
the part made of wood...

It's fragile, so you should be careful...

messages.original:
あの、まんなかにいるのが
めぐみコゾウさまたち・・・
でも、うごかない・・・
messages.translation:
Um, the ones in the middle are Megumi Kozo and the others...
But they don't move...

messages.original:
ココロあらわれるこのポーズ
・・・うつくしい・・・

めぐみさまが復活し、
動きはじめるとき・・・
何かがおこるといわれてる・・・
messages.translation:
When Megumi-sama revives and begins to move...
it's said that something will happen...

messages.original:
ここ、めぐみの広場・・・
魔ブタの魔法さえとければ、
もっとキレイなところ・・・
messages.translation:
Here, Megumi's Square...
If only I could remove the magic of the demon pig,
there would be a more beautiful place...

messages.original:
キノコの森には
怪物がすんでるというウワサ・・・
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
There's a rumor that a monster lives in the mushroom forest...
You should be careful...

messages.original:
めぐみさま・・・
やっぱり動かない・・・

そう言えば、めぐみさまの
動いてるところ・・・
だれも見たことない・・・
messages.translation: Come to think of it, no one has ever seen Megumi-sama's moving…

messages.original:
わし、きょうは村の
地下ロウの見はり当番・・・

あれ?これ、
ないしょだったっけ??
messages.translation:
Today, I'm on watch duty in the village's underground passage...

Huh? Wasn't this supposed to be a secret??

messages.original:
この森も、昔はキレイな花が
いっぱい咲いてた・・・
これもみんな、魔ブタのせい・・・
messages.translation:
This forest too used to be full of beautiful flowers...
But now, it's all because of the demon pigs...

messages.original:
魔ブタのかくれ家、
目には見えないらしい・・・

でも、入口は
どこかにあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
The devil pig's hideout,
it seems invisible to the eye...

But, the entrance must be somewhere...

messages.original: ここは・・・もう知ってるよね・・・
messages.translation: You already know this place, right?

messages.original:
バッカスの湖にある水は、
ぜんぶアルコール・・・

よっぱらうから、
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
The water in Lake Bacchus is all alcohol...

Because it's intoxicating, you should be careful...

messages.original:
めぐみさまを復活させるには
なにかが必要らしい・・・

え〜と・・・
どわすれした・・・
messages.translation:
It seems like something is needed to revive Megumi-sama...

Um...
I forgot...

messages.original:
ん?・・・
めぐみさまを復活させるもの?

・・・そういえば、なにかの
ナミダが必要とか・・・
messages.translation:
Hmm?...
Something to revive Megumi-sama?

...Come to think of it, something
requires tears...

messages.original:
めぐみコゾウさま、
人気者・・・みんな、
この広場にあつまってくる
messages.translation:
Megumi Kozo-sama,
Popular... everyone,
gathers in this square.

messages.original:
嵐の山にも魔ブタの魔法が
かかっているらしい・・・
封印ぶくろ、どこかにあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
It seems the magic of the demon pig is also on the stormy mountain...
The sealed bag must be somewhere...

messages.original:
ときどき、森の地面の下から、
ものおとがきこえてくる・・・
ちょっとコワイ・・・
messages.translation:
Sometimes, from under the forest floor,
I hear footsteps...
It's a little scary...

messages.original:
シーフマンション、
たくさんの小部屋がある

・・・全部見たか?
・・・たいへんだけど・・・
messages.translation:
Seaf Mansion,
there are many small rooms.

...Have you seen them all?
...It's tough though...

messages.original:
この先のリーフスライダーをぬけて、
キノコの森を左に行けば、
近道がある・・・
messages.translation:
Go past the leaf slider ahead,
and if you go left through the mushroom forest,
there's a shortcut...

messages.original:
キノコの森のむこうがわには、
バッカスの村と湖がある・・・
messages.translation: Beyond the mushroom forest lies the village of Bacchus and a lake...

messages.original:
1000年の宝箱に いどうにべんりな
グルピン かくされているらしい・・・
messages.translation: It seems a convenient Gurupin is hidden in the 1000-year treasure chest...

messages.original:
なかま・・・みつかっていない・・・
ここからさきは いかないほうがいい
messages.translation:
I haven't found my companion...
It's better not to go any further from here.

messages.original:
ドワーフのこども 迷子になった・・・
もりのおくへ いかないように
みはってる・・・
messages.translation:
A dwarf child got lost...
Don't go deep into the forest.
It's spreading...

messages.original:
よぉ!びっくりしたかい?
・・・オレは、カレハチョウを集めてるんだ・・・
messages.translation:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting butterflies...

messages.original:
ウワサによると、
カレハチョウにはふしぎな力があって・・・
何匹か集めるとスゴイことがおこるらしいゼ・・・
messages.translation:
According to rumors,
the butterfly has mysterious powers...
Apparently, if you gather several of them, something amazing happens...

messages.original:
何がおこるか、もし見たいんだったら、
つかまえた カレハチョウを
このムシカゴの中に入れてくれよ
messages.translation:
If you want to see what happens,
put the butterfly I caught inside this mug.

messages.original:
なんだ・・・
もうもってたのか・・・
messages.translation:
What...
Did you already have it...?

messages.original:
ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今・・・
00匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
Hii... fuu... mi...
The butterflies are now...
About 00 or so...

messages.original:
今回のバージョンは、ここまでです。
この先のエリアに進むと
ゲームは自動的に終了します。
messages.translation:
This version ends here.
If you proceed to the next area,
the game will automatically end.

messages.original:
ありゃりゃ・・・もう見つかっちゃった
・・・よーし、つぎで しょうぶだ!
messages.translation:
Oh dear... I've already been found.
...Alright, next up is the iris!

messages.original:
・・・おっ、やっと気がついたかい
・・・いやぁ、ひどい目にあったなぁ

・・・しばらく空を飛んだかとおもえば、
とちゅうで虫カゴはバラバラ・・・

気がついたら、こんなところに
落とされちまった・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh, finally you've noticed?
...Wow, I got into a terrible situation.

...Just when I thought I'd been flying through the sky for a while,
the insect cage fell apart mid-flight...

Before I knew it, I was dropped into this place...

messages.original:
やめた、やめた!・・・
何が伝説のカレハチョウだよ・・・

あんたも あきらめたほうがいいゼ
・・・え?チョウ?・・・ああ、

カレハチョウなら そこの
タマゴみたいなものに集まってるぜ
まったく、何だったんだよ・・・

じやぁ、オレはもう行くゼ・・・って、
ここはいったいドコなんだ?
messages.translation:
Stopped, stopped!...
What's this legendary swallowtail butterfly...?

You should give up too, you know.
...Huh? A butterfly?... Oh,

If it's a swallowtail butterfly, they're gathering around those egg-like things over there.
Seriously, what was that all about...?

Well then, I'm off now... wait, where am I?

messages.original:
始まりの村で、サンタとかいう
サルみかけた・・・
はらへって動けないとかなんとか・・・
messages.translation:
In the starting village, I saw something like Santa...
It looked like a monkey...
I was hungry and couldn't move, or something like that...

messages.original:
トンバも めぐみコゾウさま 見にきたか?
・・・きっといいことある・・・
たぶん・・・
messages.translation:
Tonba too, Megumi Kozou-sama, did you come to see?
...I'm sure something good will happen...
Probably...

messages.original:
マグマのどうくつも
魔ブタの魔法かかってる

・・・炎けすには
魔ブタを封印しなければ・・・
messages.translation:
The magma's clouds too
are under the spell of the demon pig's magic.

...To extinguish the flames,
we must seal the demon pig...

messages.original:
シーフマンション・・・むかし、
とうぞくの すみかだったところ・・・
messages.translation:
Seaf Mansion… once,
it was a place where the Touzoku lived…

messages.original:
ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今3匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
Hii... fuu... mi...
There are about three butterflies now...

messages.original:
ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今4匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
Hii... fuu... mi...
There are about four butterflies now...

messages.original:
ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今5匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
Hii... fuu... mi...
There are about five butterflies now...

messages.original:
ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今6匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
Hii... fuu... mi...
